characters.description: He's always helping his parents with the date palm harvest.

characters.description: His bandana is meant as a style statement,\nbut it's often mistaken for a bandage at first.
characters.name: Shakir Zahir

characters.description: He can't get enough of hobz bread smothered in hummus.
characters.name: Asad Gheisari

characters.description: Grew his hair long just to have it cut by a hairstylist.
characters.name: Batal Majid

characters.description: A motorsports fanatic who'll travel all the way to\nBahrain to catch a race live.
characters.name: Qamar Sadir

characters.description: Hailing from Dhahran, where summers scorch and winters freeze,\nhe's forged mental strength that few can match.
characters.name: Khalil Haddaoui

characters.description: Tries everything to get as tough as <FST:ASAD>,\nthough success has so far eluded him.
characters.name: Nazim Nizar

characters.description: Values elegance above all else and never skips his\npost-meal Arabica coffee.
characters.name: Tamir Nasr

characters.description: Loves tearing across the desert on camelback,\nand his camel impression is something to behold.
characters.name: Rashid Hakim

characters.description: The Captain of Shamshir's style is akin\nto that of a fierce lion.
characters.name: Said Ashraf

characters.description: A master of kabsa, the rice dish he loves serving\nto his teammates after practice.
characters.name: Qasim Batal

characters.description: His massive arms unleash elbow strikes powerful enough\nto drop an opponent in one hit.
characters.name: Udom Kaochuea

characters.description: A former Muay Thai fighter who brought his lethal kicks\nto the pitch, expanding his reach as a true warrior.
characters.name: Yuth Poonlarp

characters.description: Captain of the Muay Tigers, known for roaring a battle cry\nbefore every match.
characters.name: Napa Rattana

characters.description: An elephant handler who commands the others with ease—\nsometimes even taking his teammates for a ride.
characters.name: Naid Sirisukha

characters.description: Burning with passion for spicy and sour soup,\nshe roams restaurants in search of the perfect bowl.
characters.name: Solada Kulkit

characters.description: A late riser who's hardly recognizable until noon.\nHonestly, it's doubtful he's ever shown up to morning practice.
characters.name: Suchart Chaowarat

characters.description: He and <FST:SARIT> go way back—childhood friends turned rivals.\nSerious and driven, he puts his all into everything he does.
characters.name: Naowarat Rahman

characters.description: Her parents run a floating market, so she's been living life\non the water since she was little.
characters.name: Mei Chaptri

characters.description: The brains to <FLC:SAGOT>'s brawn, <FST:BARK> plays\nwith effortless grace and precision.
characters.name: Bhak Sepakroh

characters.description: Called the force behind <FST:BARK>'s technique, <FLC:SAGOT> charges\nthrough defenses with raw force and fearless energy.
characters.name: Klaharn Sangsorn

characters.description: Chosen to captain the Thai national team, but he stepped aside,\ninsisting <FST:NAPA> was the better fit.
characters.name: Tamgan Jaa

characters.description: He closes his eyes to block out distractions,\nrelying on wind and sound to defend.
characters.name: Aleksei Karimov

characters.description: Lives on naan, a round bread he packs even on trips abroad.
characters.name: Sergei Chernov

characters.description: The shadowy strategist behind <FST:DOMITRI>,\nalways plotting the smartest move.
characters.name: Mitya Eremin

characters.description: New to football, but his raw instinct earned him a spot\non the national team.
characters.name: Yuri Avelin

characters.description: Loves grilled skewers, though he's been cutting back\nafter <FST:RUSLAN> told him to slim down.
characters.name: Kenja Jo'rayev

characters.description: Formed a three-person band with <FST:YURI> and <FST:ZAUR>...\nthough all they can play is bass.
characters.name: Leonid Mirzayev

characters.description: Links up with defender <FST:MITYA> to relay instructions\nto the front line.
characters.name: Ruslan Kashimov

characters.description: A rock-climbing enthusiast who's scaled the famous\nGreater Chimgan mountain multiple times.
characters.name: Aaron Gachinsky

characters.description: A power striker from Uzbekistan who quietly sees\n<FST:DOMITRI> as a rival.
characters.name: Maxim Adrov

characters.description: Captain of the Storm Wolves, leading more with his play\nthan with words.
characters.name: Domitri Sobirov

characters.description: First item on the agenda each morning:\nplanning the day with tarot cards.
characters.name: Zafar Malayev

characters.description: The oldest member of Silica Eleven wears an eyepatch\nto match his seniority.
characters.name: B'adaen

characters.description: Was raised with <FST:DUFF> like a brother, which is precisely\nwhy their teamwork is beyond great.
characters.name: G'ob

characters.description: Leverages his strong build for powerful plays, but is timid\nand drifts along like shifting sand.
characters.name: A'ddah

characters.description: The hardest-headed member of Silica Eleven,\nhis rocklike forehead makes for devastating headers.
characters.name: R'adji

characters.description: Long limbs give him an unusually wide defensive range,\nand once he traps an opponent, there's no escape.
characters.name: A'kra

characters.description: Looks up to <FST:KAZERMA> like an older brother, and uses nimble moves\nto outsmart opponents and steal the ball.
characters.name: N'ameeb

characters.description: The Captain of Silica Eleven believes every match\nshould be played fair and square.
characters.name: K'aran

characters.description: Aggressive but admiring of strength, he's the type\nto always trail someone he respects.
characters.name: K'al

characters.description: Struggles to act on his own and searches for someone\nto give him the right instructions.
characters.name: S'haha

characters.description: <FST:KAZERMA>'s close friend and trusted confidant who quietly\nsupports the hot-headed forwards.
characters.name: S'harqiyah

characters.description: A rare red-eyed descendant whose physical ability\nstands out on the team.
characters.name: A'tac

characters.description: One of Falam Orbius's Purple Emperors,\nhe tries to solve every problem with brute force.
characters.name: Ogar Circes

characters.description: Follows any order from <FST:POWAI> to the letter,\nno matter how difficult.
characters.name: Van Tarel

characters.description: A player who doubles as a coordinator that has a\nknack for housework—cleaning in particular.
characters.name: Squalcha Nhess

characters.description: He notices even the tiniest things and calls them out\nwith surprising courtesy.
characters.name: Sog Galily

characters.description: Always at <FST:POWAI>'s side, curious and chasing fun\nwherever it can be found.
characters.name: Tinkel Urmia

characters.description: The captain of Naiadi Eleven picks strategies based solely on\nher mood and whims.
characters.name: Plink Powai

characters.description: Quiet and seemingly strong, but actually the loneliest\nmember of the team.
characters.name: Puddel Khaspian

characters.description: While somewhat reserved, she's an excellent listener\nand often sought out for life advice.
characters.name: Sploosh Saroma

characters.description: Obsessed with style and secretly convinced\nshe's the cutest of them all.
characters.name: Droplit Turkana

characters.description: His looks have won plenty of fangirls, but <FST:CHULKA>\nis the one calling the shots.
characters.name: Plip Batur

characters.description: Can read Aethyrs, yet his innocence makes him take\njokes and lies at face value.
characters.name: Serban Bacha

characters.description: The team's muscle who handles all the heavy lifting,\nhe's often used as a stepstool by <FST:URMI>.
characters.name: Plunk Balkhash

characters.description: One of Falam Orbius's Purple Emperors,\nshe's said to command water with ease.
characters.name: Rondula Flehl

characters.description: The captain of Magmavia Eleven is proud of the power\nhe gained upon giving up his wings.
characters.name: Aoba Gyr

characters.description: Giving up their wings side by side, she and <FST:ALBEGA>\nshare a past no one else can touch.
characters.name: Mayon Langcrest

characters.description: Always chasing the new, he was the first on the team\nto trade wings for a mechanical arm.
characters.name: Merapil Sekretair

characters.description: A master at sneaking up silently and stealing the ball,\nshe's quiet and easy to overlook.
characters.name: Misty Aul

characters.description: Magmavia Eleven's most passionate player,\nintense and unstoppable once he takes a liking to you.
characters.name: Nevado Condorum

characters.description: A cute player who's won over all of Magmavia,\nwith skill to match her looks.
characters.name: Etna Horx

characters.description: Secretly in love with <FST:ETUNA>, he gives everything on the pitch\nto impress her.
characters.name: Promon Shubill

characters.description: He's handsome by Magmavia's standards\nand popular with everyone.
characters.name: Cotopax Gerigar

characters.description: <FST:ALBEGA>'s right-hand man is respected by the elders\nand carries more than his fair share of burdens.
characters.name: Vesuvion Bubo

characters.description: Always found at <FST:CONDALME>'s side.\nYet, what he's thinking remains a complete mystery.
characters.name: Tar Parky

characters.description: Fated rivals with <FST:ALBEGA>, they called a temporary truce\nto face a planetary crisis together.
characters.name: Nyira Fezun

characters.description: One of Falam Orbius's Purple Emperors,\nhe's devious and stops at nothing to achieve his goals.
characters.name: Bala Gasgula

characters.description: A player with no standout traits and no weaknesses,\nfully trusted by Captain <FST:STAGG>.
characters.name: Ceram Longicorn

characters.description: A defender as tough as armor who shrugs off ordinary tackles\nwithout a flinch.
characters.name: Romborina Drohn

characters.description: Sprinkles glittering scales with every move.\nWhile mostly harmless, he is annoyingly persistent.
characters.name: Heterocera Mothlin

characters.description: Small but insanely strong, and stubborn enough\nto be a real threat.
characters.name: Formica Anz

characters.description: A legendary hunter from Juuro Village who's new to football\nbut full of potential.
characters.name: Mantodea Mantus

characters.description: Just emerged from her chrysalis, she's in her prime\nand her abilities have skyrocketed.
characters.name: Lepidoptera Flutterby

characters.description: A calm striker for Fertilia Eleven, always composed and precise,\neven under pressure.
characters.name: Vespa Hornest

characters.description: His incredible legs let him leap five meters straight up\nand fifteen on a run.
characters.name: Caelif Hopper

characters.description: The oldest member and captain of Fertilia Eleven,\nhe's lived far longer than most of his kind.
characters.name: Lucan Stag

characters.description: The team's mood-maker, he's endlessly curious\nand blessed with extraordinary athleticism.
characters.name: Banda Crix

characters.description: <LAF:STAGG>'s childhood friend, who fought alongside him\nuntil taking his last breath in a football battle.
characters.name: Schisto Locus

characters.description: One of Falam Orbius's Purple Emperors, his combination\nmoves with his brother <FST:GANDARES> never cease to amaze.
characters.name: Ruger Baran

characters.description: One of Falam Orbius's Purple Emperors,\nhe's utterly convinced that his brother <FST:RYUGEL> is a genius.
characters.name: Gandares Baran

characters.description: Son of <FST:BANDA>, the Fertilia Eleven player who\nlost his life during the match against Earth Eleven.
characters.name: Banda Crix Junior

characters.description: Bright and bubbly, he dreams of befriending every rival\nand throwing one huge festival for all.
characters.name: Mayen Harmet

characters.description: A seasoned diver with lungs of steel and a pompadour\nthat somehow stays rock solid underwater.
characters.name: Trevin Seabourne

characters.description: Plays to vent stress but gets banged up chasing every ball\nlike it's life or death.
characters.name: Jory Jinx

characters.description: Once timid, she found her fire watching the old headmaster's\nteam and swore she'd never stay quiet again.
characters.name: Clementine Weston

characters.description: Handy with a needle, she patches uniforms on the fly\nand sometimes embroiders jackets for cash.
characters.name: Orfreya Newcomb

characters.description: A beloved PE teacher whose kindness gets him tricked\nmore often than he cares to admit.
characters.name: Conrado Pottinger

characters.description: Graceful and thoughtful, she's the team's sweetheart\nand everyone's favorite shoulder to lean on.
characters.name: Celeste Fairbourne

characters.description: A model born to fame who demands perfection\nfrom her squad and twice as much from herself.
characters.name: Celina Lavelle

characters.description: Quick to want what others have,\nshe loses interest the moment it's hers.
characters.name: Clarisse Luxe

characters.description: An inventor's daughter and robotics champion\nwho trains with robots she built herself.
characters.name: Adelina Gearhart

characters.description: Built like a pro, she crushes the pitch with raw power\nand muscle-driven plays.
characters.name: Eliza Florence

characters.description: A commanding presence hailed as the guardian deity\nof Falam Medius, and a goalkeeper of remarkable skill.
characters.name: Argon Bulgess

characters.description: Always tweaking his look and mannerisms to stand out,\nyet still frustrated that he barely registers within the team.
characters.name: Xenon Reith

characters.description: Can scarcely see past his bangs, relying instead on\nsharp hearing and horn-like feelers to read the field.
characters.name: Radon Mons

characters.description: Loves to cook, showing up on match and practice days\nwith homemade lunches for the whole squad.
characters.name: Selenia Mund

characters.description: Lives by the motto of having fun, treating even matches\nagainst Earthlings as nothing more than play.
characters.name: Neon Rotarus

characters.description: Keeps a cool face but hates to lose, quietly eyeing\na future seat among the Purple Emperors.
characters.name: Brimstone Bol

characters.description: Known as Ixar Fleet's Shadow Shooter, he tears apart\nanyone foolish enough to approach his goal.
characters.name: Phobos Quasar

characters.description: Once a scholar and still brilliantly sharp, he even helps\ndraft <FLC:OZROCK>'s strategic plans.
characters.name: Aegir Cepheid

characters.description: A loyal subordinate to <FLC:OZROCK> who pushed their schemes\nforward by exploiting his role on the tournament committee.
characters.name: Meteo Garnet

characters.description: An enraged strike captain fighting to avenge a friend\nlost during Falam Orbius's invasion.
characters.name: Deimos Lepton

characters.description: Left with almost no memories after the war,\nhe now fights on raw, instinctive aggression alone.
characters.name: Ymir Catena

characters.description: A player and coordinator who worries about\nher team members' futures rather than their pasts.
characters.name: Sinope Linea

characters.description: Fights driven by desire, taking more pleasure\nin showing his strength than in revenge.
characters.name: Tarvos Boson

characters.description: Possesses a sixth-sense ability, sensing opponents'\nmovements through subtle shifts in presence.
characters.name: Dione Bolide

characters.description: While once beloved by children, past despair has\nhardened her into someone almost unrecognizable.
characters.name: Despina Lux

characters.description: Orchestrated a galaxy-spanning tournament to\nseize control of the Cosmic Plasma.
characters.name: Ozrock Boldar

characters.description: A warrior who channels hatred into power and\nobeys <FLC:OZROCK> without question.
characters.name: Loge Colles

characters.description: A powerhouse ax wielder who can go toe-to-toe\nwith <FST:SARGES> in single combat.
characters.name: Strem Goozer

characters.description: Former knight and scout whose vision and speed\nmake him a threat on the pitch.
characters.name: Fow Tudas

characters.description: Lost to <FST:SARGES> in the tournament final, then came back\nnext year to win and join the knights.
characters.name: Cherio Pardon

characters.description: Ex-captain who defended the kingdom and stepped aside\nfor <FST:SARGES> out of respect.
characters.name: Bambaros Tower

characters.description: Veteran commander of the kingdom's heavy cavalry\nwho fought alongside <FST:BAMBAROS>.
characters.name: Zartan Walder

characters.description: A master archer whose surprise-attack skills make\nhim a constant threat on the pitch.
characters.name: Zyne Hanging

characters.description: A genius strategist for the knights who recognized\n<FST:SARGES>'s power and put it to use.
characters.name: Madison Barada

characters.description: An astrologer who foresaw <FST:SARGES>'s death and\nlaments failing to protect him.
characters.name: Bindal Hermit

characters.description: Senior to <FST:SARGES> in the knights, though everyone\nhas long forgotten it.
characters.name: Astro Justin

characters.description: A legendary warrior of planet Nomor reincarnated,\nand the white Picksie who appeared before <FST:TENMA>.
characters.name: Circulus Corona

characters.description: A fearless vanguard who charged first into enemy lines\nand admired <FST:SARGES> as his "brother."
characters.name: Joss Fool

characters.description: A fearless hunter from a planet ruled by colossal beasts,\nunmatched in her ability to take them down.
characters.name: Ashvina Bharani

characters.description: Discovered by <FST:ACLOUS> on a planet with a lethal,\ngas-filled environment and promptly scouted.
characters.name: Hastar Savitar

characters.description: He can stretch and retract his body hair at will,\na quirk he uses purely for fun.
characters.name: Apas Mulan

characters.description: Has a unique perspective as he comes from a people\nwhose eyes can see the past.
characters.name: Soma Lobi

characters.description: This scholar from an advanced world was forced\nto submit after his civilization fell.
characters.name: Rudra Ardo

characters.description: Built like a tank, he was scouted from a planet\nwith crushing gravity.
characters.name: Bhaga Guni

characters.description: A grandmaster survivalist hailing from a planet\ndominated by toxic swamps.
characters.name: Bass Danish

characters.description: Raised on a planet where fireballs fall by day\nand icicles by night, he thrives in any condition.
characters.name: Indra Vayu

characters.description: Immortal and agile, he strikes with insect-like\nreflexes honed over countless battles.
characters.name: Mitra Jeshu

characters.description: The king of Falam Orbius reborn, appearing as the\nblack Picksie before <FLC:TSURUGI>.
characters.name: Arculus Orbes

characters.description: A sensitive player with a cluster of 80,000 eyes\nand a keen sense of touch.
characters.name: Ashley Sarpala

characters.description: Towering but surprisingly nimble, he leaps to snatch\nsand snakes and devours them immediately.
characters.name: Jabhat Graffias

characters.description: The fastest across desert sands, even shifting dunes\ncan't slow him down.
characters.name: Lesath Tine

characters.description: A shadowy figure rumored to be an assassin, though\nsome claim he's just naturally easy to overlook.
characters.name: Akram Alvayra

characters.description: Boisterous and larger than life, he's rough but\nfiercely protective of those who look up to him.
characters.name: Calkrab Antares

characters.description: Strikingly beautiful with a razor-sharp tongue, she's\ncrushed countless hearts without effort.
characters.name: Shaula Toxbarb

characters.description: Silica's sand-karate champion, skilled at blinding\nopponents with quick throws of sand.
characters.name: Res Ord

characters.description: A tenacious defender who clings to opponents\nwith relentless precision.
characters.name: Doro Might

characters.description: A heartthrob and three-time back-to-back champion\nof the Tough-skin Contest.
characters.name: Craig Chart

characters.description: The reigning hoverboard champion, known for her\ncute looks and frequent appearances on TV.
characters.name: Mesa Bute

characters.description: Enjoys seeing others struggle, though he lacks\nthe courage to make it happen himself.
characters.name: Sad Sajord

characters.description: A mischievous trickster who loves setting pitfalls\nand sometimes causes travelers to get lost.
characters.name: Silt Deigan

characters.description: Light on his feet and a master of breakdancing\nwho can spin endlessly on the sand.
characters.name: Cord Ratozol

characters.description: A sand-swimming master famed for escaping\neven quicksand without breaking a sweat.
characters.name: Warim Kalkawa

characters.description: A rising star in Silica's beauty world, known\nfor her hit mud-based cosmetics.
characters.name: Nomare Lusha

characters.description: Three-time runner-up in the Tough-skin Contest,\nfiercely rivaling the current champion, <FST:KAKUGAN>.
characters.name: Dry Karwack

characters.description: A promising sand artist whose intricate sand castles\nare displayed in museums.
characters.name: Nenban Slate

characters.description: A genius inventor whose creations help power\nthe floating technology behind hoverboards.
characters.name: Wacke Koshra

characters.description: Born to a prominent Silica family, he values courtesy\nand earns genuine respect without arrogance.
characters.name: Arenite Serka

characters.description: His parents run a desert palm farm, and he often\nreceives shipments from home.
characters.name: Feriando Hidery

characters.description: Loves sand baths and travels deserts just to enjoy\nbeing buried in the sand.
characters.name: Foggara Kanart

characters.description: A skilled cook who treats teammates, though\nonly interested in frying and grilling.
characters.name: Flint Heutch

characters.description: Collects pretty stones and is always scanning\nthe ground for new ones.
characters.name: Jari Baras

characters.description: Iron-willed despite a frail body, this player fasts\nfor spiritual discipline.
characters.name: Hika Rabeer

characters.description: Curious about everything but loses interest fast—\na typical hot-and-cold type.
characters.name: Dervan Yorhal

characters.description: A sand-wrestling powerhouse aiming to go pro,\nalready set on the mask he'll wear.
characters.name: Kudon Kanran

characters.description: Fearless foodie who tries anything edible, hell-bent\non learning from every stomach-churning mishap.
characters.name: Derika Cachil

characters.description: Fashion-lover with a short attention span who's\nalways changing her hair and color.
characters.name: Gupas Melaka

characters.description: Possesses beautiful hair, though those unruly curls\ncoil around his neck and cause him trouble.
characters.name: Catro Corydoras

characters.description: A dependable organizer whose eyes gleam and shift color with the light.
characters.name: Tetrae Charlong

characters.description: Constantly moving as a child, he grew up outgoing\nand able to make friends anywhere.
characters.name: Guramki Abantis

characters.description: So painfully shy that her bangs spike up in panic\nwhenever all eyes are on her.
characters.name: Hatara Tehaze

characters.description: Cheerful yet fond of dark, cramped spaces,\noften found napping in a quiet corner.
characters.name: Kiroh Beira

characters.description: A fortune-telling enthusiast whose hair whirls\nin spirals whenever he reads a fortune.
characters.name: Uzma Kyallak

characters.description: A dependable, caring presence whose hair flares\nand glows when she's angry.
characters.name: Bettas Renden

characters.description: Appears carefree at first, but is actually delicate\nand easily falls ill.
characters.name: Durmali Altos

characters.description: Quiet and reserved by day, but an\nunpredictable party animal by night.
characters.name: Unahr Giil

characters.description: Loves diving for beautiful shells, eating the meat\nand displaying the shells at home.
characters.name: Holsten Leebrook

characters.description: Strong and brave, a dependable tough guy,\nyet an extreme idol fan famous nationwide.
characters.name: Anky Mo

characters.description: Skilled at household chores and supportive of men.\nQuite the rare presence in female-dominated Naiadi.
characters.name: Menoh Seaweed

characters.description: Though she looks sharp, she's highly considerate\nand a real social butterfly.
characters.name: Sierra Mone

characters.description: Hard to read, but a true festival lover who's\nalways drawn to crowds.
characters.name: Piranu Rajelly

characters.description: A student who also works as an idol, admired for\nboth her looks and charming gestures.
characters.name: Claria Leone

characters.description: Known for his glowing accessories, with orders\npouring in from neighboring domes.
characters.name: Umral Seaslug

characters.description: Loves swimming near the surface on sunny days,\nsparkling like a playful fairy in the sunlight.
characters.name: Cherrie Menjikko

characters.description: Deceptively quiet, he hides a fierce aggression that\nmakes every encounter on the pitch dangerous.
characters.name: Sambas Soya

characters.description: A true noble descended from a royal line who\nradiates an intimidating aura.
characters.name: Oggris Roya

characters.description: Brutishly strong and reckless, he breaks things\nin his path but proves dependable on the pitch.
characters.name: Galiaf Satonga

characters.description: Swims with her hair flowing like wings, enchanting\neveryone like a butterfly of the sea.
characters.name: Eli Mantary

characters.description: Those who can't read the dark nature his innocent\neyes belie are bound to walk straight into trouble.
characters.name: Teodorus Toxsin

characters.description: Draws people in with charm and conversation.\nThough get too close, and you're in for a world of hurt.
characters.name: Minack Sargo

characters.description: Flaunts some of Magmavia's most beautiful feathers\nand is a favorite in the media.
characters.name: Kazar Kibane

characters.description: His belief that wit and beauty are everything puts\nhim in constant conflict with his brother <FST:KUKUDUR>.
characters.name: Doyle Coco

characters.description: Values strength above all, clashing endlessly\nwith his younger brother <FST:PYOL>.
characters.name: Kreaton Coco

characters.description: A celebrated dancer whose bold, graceful performances\nare a beloved sight among the people of Magmavia.
characters.name: Kanzan Focho

characters.description: Easily startled, though her nervousness has earned her\na quiet fanbase who find it endearing.
characters.name: Hattar Meppo

characters.description: A master miner with a powerful beak, able to extract\nore without ever touching a pickaxe.
characters.name: Ilka Rugar

characters.description: Gave up his wings to become a pilot, dreaming\nof flying massive aircraft through the skies.
characters.name: Jan Suparo

characters.description: Shadowy leader of Newcrest's Reef Rats, marked\nby a cross-shaped scar from a clash three years past.
characters.name: Korum Jintal

characters.description: <FST:KOTY>'s loyal bodyguard, whose mechanical arm\nhas been illegally enhanced for greater strength.
characters.name: Perrick Ambin

characters.description: A mad scientist obsessed with modifications\nwho secretly tinkers with others' arms.
characters.name: Hick Idris

characters.description: A feared lone wolf who can nap with his eyes open,\nearning him the nickname "Sleeping Lion."
characters.name: Hashi Bilocco

characters.description: Hosts friends in his colorful garden, singing\nand enjoying their company.
characters.name: Karka Poe

characters.description: Cunning and ruthless, he runs Newcrest's\nPyroclast Gang and has long been <FST:KOTY>'s rival.
characters.name: Bo Lourdash

characters.description: A mother of many and MVP of the Moms' League.
characters.name: Mendry Charbeau

characters.description: A charming heartthrob with a fan club, whose\nsharp brows drive women wild.
characters.name: Iyer Zuck

characters.description: A refined Magmavia poet whose beautiful voice\ncaptivates anyone who hears it.
characters.name: Ugwis Ann

characters.description: Magmavia's most alluring beauty, using a teasing\ncharm that keeps men guessing.

hissatsu.description: Channel cosmic energy through your legs\nand spiral the shot with overwhelming force.
hissatsu.name: Overclock Spiral

hissatsu.description: Lock eyes on the goal and deliver a full-swing\nheader with deadly precision.
hissatsu.name: Driving Header

hissatsu.description: Use the goalpost to execute air somersaults and make\na splendid landing right on top of incoming shots.
hissatsu.name: Somersault Stamp

hissatsu.description: Strike with a powerful shot that lands\nlike a boxer's devastating straight punch.
hissatsu.name: Straight Counter

hissatsu.description: Use high voltage to surround the ball with plasma\nbefore shooting it low at the goal.
hissatsu.name: Plasma Ball

hissatsu.description: Radiate a heavenly light to blind opponents\nand burst through in one swift move.
hissatsu.name: Divine Dummy

hissatsu.description: Gather every ounce of power and catch the ball\nin a dazzling display of determination and skill.
hissatsu.name: Stillness Drip

hissatsu.description: Harnessing the power of the sun, this overhead kick\nturns the ball into a radiant bird that flies forth\nwith unstoppable force.
hissatsu.name: Golden Gull

hissatsu.description: The player stands tall with arms folded as a\nwhirlpool underfoot turns into a dragon and\nattacks the opponent.
hissatsu.name: Black Tide Ride

hissatsu.description: Call upon Odin Mk-2's power to swing an\nenlarged spear as you fire the shot.
hissatsu.name: Majestic Radiance

hissatsu.description: Spin hand-in-hand with a teammate, whipping\nup leaves as you barrel forward.
hissatsu.name: Verdure Vortex

hissatsu.description: A dazzlingly cute and magical show\nfires a heart-shaped arrow shot.
hissatsu.name: Cupid's Arrow

hissatsu.description: Launch a triple Fire Tornado with three blazing\nspirals that crash together into one brutal shot.
hissatsu.name: Fire Tornado TC

hissatsu.description: Melt into liquid form to flow around\nthe defender before they can react.
hissatsu.name: Hydro Flow

hissatsu.description: A brilliant aura transforms into a towering blade\nthat slices incoming shots into two.
hissatsu.name: Galatyn

hissatsu.description: Fire beams from a multitude of magical circles,\ndelivering cosmic justice to the enemy.
hissatsu.name: Judgment Ray

hissatsu.description: With a wild shout and a mighty stomp,\ncall forth a titanic foot from the skies\nto smash down on your foe.
hissatsu.name: Vigorous Stomp

hissatsu.description: Spin the ball with both feet to charge energy and\nfire it like a devastating plasma cannon.
hissatsu.name: Centrifugal Blast

hissatsu.description: Spin rapidly to unleash a willy-willy dust devil\nand blast foes aside.
hissatsu.name: Willy-Willy

hissatsu.description: Charge the ball with rapid kicks,\nthen unleash a powerful blast shot!
hissatsu.name: The Detonator

hissatsu.description: A cleansing light from the sky seals up the ball's\nmomentum.
hissatsu.name: Celestial Zone

hissatsu.description: A light storm sweeps through the pitch and blows\neverything away as it heads for the goal.\n
hissatsu.name: White Hurricane

hissatsu.description: A light storm sweeps through the pitch and blows\neverything away as it heads for the goal.\n
hissatsu.name: White Hurricane

hissatsu.description: Infuse the ball with shadow energy and shoot.\nIts effectiveness is that of a deadly blade\nwrapped in dark flames.
hissatsu.name: Doomsword Slash

hissatsu.description: Whip up a mixture of gloopy goo.\nVigorously stretch it out and mix in the ball to trap it.
hissatsu.name: Goopy Gloopy Goo

hissatsu.description: Focus power into a fist and swing it down angrily\nwith the Majin's support to put a stop to incoming\nshots.
hissatsu.name: Hammer of Fury

hissatsu.description: Conjure a portal connected to other planes,\nswallowing up any kind of shot!
hissatsu.name: Wormhole

hissatsu.description: A conducted shot of orchestral magnificence\nthat is accompanied by an exquisite melody.
hissatsu.name: Fortissimo

hissatsu.description: Block any and all shots with a giant right hand brimming\nwith passion for football.
hissatsu.name: God Hand

hissatsu.description: Construct a massive underground shelter and lock\nits layers to prevent any enemy breakthrough.
hissatsu.name: Formidable Fortress

hissatsu.description: Twist the ball between both feet to add a spin that\ncauses it to hurtle down from above like a bullet.
hissatsu.name: Gunshot

hissatsu.description: Strike with a sharp, freezing kick to unleash\na three-fold blizzard at the goal.
hissatsu.name: Triple Blizzard

hissatsu.description: Kick the ball up and surround it with a dark aura\nbefore slamming it down for an overhead shot.
hissatsu.name: Doom Dive Drive

hissatsu.description: Penetrate the goal using the aura of Odin's sword,\nsummoned via a magic circle on the ground.
hissatsu.name: Odin Sword

hissatsu.description: Line up The Wall to block opponents' dribbles\nand turn into a moving fortress of defence.
hissatsu.name: Wall for One

hissatsu.description: Whip up a tornado with nimble footwork to\nweaken the ball and seize it instantly.
hissatsu.name: Twister Trap

hissatsu.description: Muscles as strong as steel can take any shot head-on.
hissatsu.name: Toughness Block

hissatsu.description: Create a giant drill to stop the ball.\nLeave the opposition feeling empty,\nas if boring a hole in their spirits.
hissatsu.name: Drill Smasher

hissatsu.description: Three players charge the ball with thunder\nand launch it high for a lightning-like shot!
hissatsu.name: Inazuma Break

hissatsu.description: A shot that approaches the goal in a zigzag manner,\nlike fangs rushing to crush their prey.
hissatsu.name: Double Jaw

hissatsu.description: Infuse the right foot with a blazing sword that\nrips through the ground on its way to the goal.
hissatsu.name: Maximum Fire

hissatsu.description: Scan, aim, and release a lethal shot that hones\nin on the goal with unerring accuracy.
hissatsu.name: Sniper Shot

hissatsu.description: Pound the ball more than 100 times in a second to\nrepel incoming shots with full force.
hissatsu.name: Blazing Knuckle

hissatsu.description: Seize the perfect moment to strike beautifully\nand steal the ball with finesse.
hissatsu.name: Maestro's Call

hissatsu.description: Become lightning itself,\nand fire a shot that reaches the heavens!
hissatsu.name: Zigzag Zoom

hissatsu.description: Swing electrically charged hands around to create a\nlaser trap that blocks incoming shots.
hissatsu.name: Electric Trap

hissatsu.description: Awaken the demon within to unleash a supernatural\nstrike with wings of darkness.
hissatsu.name: Supernatural Strike

hissatsu.description: A special move that utilizes the flames blazing within.\nSynergy with the red-hot power of friendship\nfuels it further.
hissatsu.name: Fire Tornado DD

hissatsu.description: Catch and devour incoming shots like a spider\ncatching prey in its web.
hissatsu.name: Giant Spider

hissatsu.description: Encircle your rival in a spiraling vortex and awaken\nthe ocean's guardian to rise with a\ncrashing wave and steal the ball.
hissatsu.name: Kraken Seaquake

hissatsu.description: Form a shielded formation like ancient\nheavy infantry, shoving foes aside.
hissatsu.name: Phalanx

hissatsu.description: Gather the penguins' power into the ball,\nthen strike a fierce overhead toward the goal!
hissatsu.name: Penguin Volley

hissatsu.description: Countless aura shields block incoming shots,\nensuring the safety of the team.
hissatsu.name: Safety First

hissatsu.description: Analyze the best ball trajectory for a goal, and\nexecute a shot that follows it perfectly.
hissatsu.name: Optimal Trajectory

hissatsu.description: Generate a strong gust of wind with an explosive run\nto execute a shot that's too fast for human eyes.
hissatsu.name: Zephyr Shot

hissatsu.description: A rough and dangerous move that blows the opponent\naway with a fiery jumping kick.
hissatsu.name: Fire Drill

hissatsu.description: A variation of God Hand where a dome-shaped aura\nbursts out from the hand to turn incoming shots\naside.
hissatsu.name: Dimensional Hand

hissatsu.description: Three players come together to revive the legendary\nFenrir, whose bestial roar tears through the goal.
hissatsu.name: Grand Fenrir

hissatsu.description: Pool the power of three to summon a black hole,\nsucking in the opponent's shot.
hissatsu.name: Gravity Cage

hissatsu.description: Spin against the ball's trajectory to sap its\npower and snatch it from the air.
hissatsu.name: Tornado Catch

hissatsu.description: Spin at blazing speed to create five colossal tornadoes\nand snatch the ball away.
hissatsu.name: Tornado Barrier

hissatsu.description: A gnarly curve shot that rides the waves and\nsurges through the water tube straight for the goal.
hissatsu.name: The Tube

hissatsu.description: Light born from darkness turns into a destructive\nray in this move that unifies light and shadow.
hissatsu.name: Shadow Ray

hissatsu.description: The sea god's roar summons a tall tsunami wave\nthat forms a wall to block off incoming shots.
hissatsu.name: Tsunami Wall

hissatsu.description: Thrust out both hands like a ferocious beast baring\nfangs at incoming shots.
hissatsu.name: Beast Fang

hissatsu.description: Summon a massive black hole to crush all in its path,\npowering up Astro Break to devastating effect.
hissatsu.name: Astro Gate

hissatsu.description: Passion ignites, exploding into a scorching storm\nthat burns all in its path.

hissatsu.description: Strike the ball at superhuman speed,\nigniting it in a scorching, unstoppable shot.
hissatsu.name: Rapid Fire

hissatsu.description: Channel volcanic energy to summon lightning,\nhurling a fiery thunderball at the net.
hissatsu.name: Volcanic Lightning

hissatsu.description: Summon a virtual barrier of code and lock the ball\ninside your cybernetic domain.
hissatsu.name: Cyber Realm

hissatsu.description: A foot suddenly juts out from a portal,\ncatching the opponent off guard.
hissatsu.name: Spatial Portal

hissatsu.description: Encase the ball in frigid air, driving it\ntoward the goal with the ferocity of a polar bear.

hissatsu.description: A dense magnetic field gathers at your fingertips\nforcing even the strongest shots to the ground.
hissatsu.name: Gravity Point

hissatsu.description: Manipulate shadows to catch the ball using a\nhand filled with eerie dark energy.
hissatsu.name: Shadow Catch

hissatsu.description: A lightning-fast combination shot that evokes\nthe harmony of light and shadow like an eclipse.
hissatsu.name: Black Dawn

hissatsu.description: Execute a shot that bites into the opposing team's\ngoal like a tyrannosaurus biting into its prey.

hissatsu.description: Use Achilles D9's special function to cut through\nthe goal in a Big Bang-worthy blast.
hissatsu.name: Big Bang Slash

hissatsu.description: Take a dazzling sword and swing with all your might.\nOnly one with a royal bearing can master this skill.

hissatsu.description: The howling of a wolf, illuminated by moonlight,\nmanifested as a pinpoint shot that roars across the pitch.

hissatsu.description: Launch a triple Fire Tornado with three blazing\nspirals that crash together into one brutal shot.

hissatsu.description: Cause molten magma to erupt and harden\ninstantly, trapping the opponent's legs.
hissatsu.name: Magmire

hissatsu.description: Mastery of God Catch elevates the Majin to new heights,\ncausing its rainbow aura to seal off the goal.

hissatsu.description: Smash a header with a colossal, gigaton-charged\naura driving the ball home.

hissatsu.description: One hand rises, as if freezing time itself, stopping\nthe football's momentum and deflecting it away.

hissatsu.description: Store up power to deliver a cutting shot reminiscent\nof ancient ballista bolts.

hissatsu.description: Launch a cannon with a fiery kick and send\nthe ball hurtling toward the net.
hissatsu.name: Cannonball

hissatsu.description: Kick in sync with a shot clad in ice to drive a\ncolossal lance of darkness straight into the net.

hissatsu.description: Create a deadly triangle with your own power in\na fearsome clone version of Death Zone.
hissatsu.name: Clone Death Zone

hissatsu.description: Block the opponent's offence with a wall of blazing\nflames swirling around your body.
hissatsu.name: La Flamme

hissatsu.description: Overflowing passion manifests a giant right hand.\nBehold the mighty God Hand!
hissatsu.name: Soul Hand

hissatsu.description: Strike with a sharp, freezing kick to unleash\na three-fold blizzard at the goal.
hissatsu.name: Triple Blizzard

hissatsu.description: Read the opponent's every move and snatch\nthe ball under relentless pressure.
hissatsu.name: Copy Cut

hissatsu.description: Infuse your right hand with a dark aura that causes\nincoming shots to vanish into thin air.

hissatsu.description: Three players combine their timing and effort to\nstrike the ball like lightning with perfect teamwork.

hissatsu.description: Close in on an opponent while teleporting through\ndarkness and steal the ball in the blink of an eye.

hissatsu.description: Leap up like a flying fish in the open sea\nto fire a jump shot.

hissatsu.description: Blow a bubble around the ball and then\nkick it at the goal as a colorful stream!

hissatsu.description: Send four dragons spiraling toward the goal with\ndestructive power beyond human reckoning.

hissatsu.description: Run in a way that leaves an afterimage to distract\nthe opponent while you steal the ball.
hissatsu.name: Hyper-Swiper

hissatsu.description: Focus power into both arms to manifest the Colosseum\nas a stalwart fortress that stops incoming shots.
hissatsu.name: Colosseum Guard

hissatsu.description: Add explosive fizz to a Fire Tornado shot and\nunleash a deceptively powerful strike.
hissatsu.name: Fire Lemonade

hissatsu.description: Call forth a colossal rock hammer and\nbring it crashing down, shaking the ground\nand blasting your opponent away.
hissatsu.name: Rock Hammer

hissatsu.description: Channel God Hand's hidden power\ninto both legs for a blazing cannon shot!
hissatsu.name: Almighty Cannon

hissatsu.description: Release a mystical mist that lowers visibility and\nsteal the ball from a momentarily confused\nopponent.
hissatsu.name: Mystic Mist

hissatsu.description: Unyielding heart and burning passion call forth the Majin,\nan Inazuma legend awakened anew.
hissatsu.name: Majin the Hand

hissatsu.description: Rise with a force that could conquer raging seas\nand fire a storm shot from the eye of the typhoon!
hissatsu.name: The Typhoon

hissatsu.description: Split into three with ninja precision and slam\nthe ball down from above with triple power.
hissatsu.name: Clone Block

hissatsu.description: Launch the ball like a relentless missile,\nhammering the goal nonstop.
hissatsu.name: Assault Shot

hissatsu.description: Leap into an overhead kick and drive the ball with a\nrazor-sharp strike that mesmerizes all who watch.
hissatsu.name: Brave Shot

hissatsu.description: Seven glowing swords rip through the air hurtling\ntoward the goal.
hissatsu.name: Gladius Arch

hissatsu.description: Gather all of your strength to create a shockwave\nshield capable of blocking powerful shots.
hissatsu.name: Full Power Shield

hissatsu.description: Generate a shockwave shield in front of the goal to\nrepel even the strongest shots.
hissatsu.name: Power Shield

hissatsu.description: All body power flows into a single toe.\nA dazzling light erupts with the mighty toe kick!
hissatsu.name: Paladin Strike

hissatsu.description: Toss opponents into a lightning-charged tornado\nto shock them, then surge past.
hissatsu.name: Sparky Spin

hissatsu.description: A greatly powered-up version of The Wall that\nsummons a towering mountain to block opponents.
hissatsu.name: The Mountain

hissatsu.description: A blazing shot cloaked in fierce flames, launched\ninto the air with a fiery right-foot strike.
hissatsu.name: Fire Tornado A

hissatsu.description: Utilize kung fu moves to supercharge the strength of\na header shot.
hissatsu.name: Kung Fu Header

hissatsu.description: Emit piercing, bat-like ultrasound to pinpoint\nthe ball and snatch it with precision.
hissatsu.name: Ultrasonic

hissatsu.description: Channel the power of God Hand to leap across\nthe cosmos and slam a cosmic shot.
hissatsu.name: The Galaxy

hissatsu.description: Charge at the opponent like an ancient winged\ndinosaur swooping down with a cyclone in its wake.
hissatsu.name: Pterrordactyl Swoop

hissatsu.description: Gather infinite power from teammates and allies\nacross the universe to unleash one unstoppable shot.
hissatsu.name: The Earth: Infinity

hissatsu.description: Catch the shot with the helping hand of a\nmom fed up with her study-shirking kid!
hissatsu.name: Mama's Helping Hand

hissatsu.description: Achieved by an extraordinary jumping ability,\nleap into the air like a rabbit and deliver this acrobatic shot.
hissatsu.name: Bouncing Bunny

hissatsu.description: Unleash a tornado on the opposition\nand send them flying. Then, with the wind,\nmake a mad dash straight for the goal.
hissatsu.name: Cyclone Sprint

hissatsu.description: Kick up a cloud of sand, blind the opponent,\nand snatch the ball while they stagger.
hissatsu.name: Desert Blast

hissatsu.description: Spin the ball to build energy,\nand hit the goal with a swirling, piercing shot.
hissatsu.name: Spiral Shot

hissatsu.description: Twist and strike with the fluid grace of a mermaid\nto send the ball arcing beautifully toward the goal.
hissatsu.name: Mermaid Smash

hissatsu.description: Wrap the ball in a towering vine and strike\nthe goal with unstoppable growth.
hissatsu.name: Giant Beanstalk

hissatsu.description: Manifest eerie ball-shaped will-o'-the-wisps to\nconfuse the goalkeeper.
hissatsu.name: Phantom Shot

hissatsu.description: Steal the ball with a fiery slide tackle.\nIts fierce momentum is nigh unstoppable.
hissatsu.name: Ignited Steal

hissatsu.description: Scatter crimson-black roses in an elegant\noverhead strike of chaotic power.
hissatsu.name: Flower Plower

hissatsu.description: A restorative long shot that paints a rainbow over\nthe pitch.
hissatsu.name: Rainbow Arc

hissatsu.description: Spin hard, dive into the turf, and tunnel\nunderground to slip past the block.
hissatsu.name: Major Miner

hissatsu.description: A dirty move that finds an opening to secretly\nswitch the ball with a fake one.
hissatsu.name: Fake Ball

hissatsu.description: Call forth swirling thunderclouds that imbue the\nball with electricity before shooting.
hissatsu.name: Thundertaker

hissatsu.description: Stamp the ball and unleash a cascade of notes\nto orchestrate a dazzling breakthrough.
hissatsu.name: Diffusal Chord

hissatsu.description: A double sliding tackle executed at full force that\ncleanly reaps the opponent's ball away.
hissatsu.name: Harvest

hissatsu.description: The ball is passed between two players at high speed\nuntil it seems to split into two.
hissatsu.name: Dual Strike

hissatsu.description: One player aims the shot while another fires it like\na matchlock bullet.
hissatsu.name: Matchlock Bullet

hissatsu.description: Imbue the ball with explosive solar\nenergy and fire off a shot engulfed in crimson flames.
hissatsu.name: Atomic Flare

hissatsu.description: This shot is many times more fang-tastically\npowerful than Jurassic Jaws.
hissatsu.name: Fangtasmagoria

hissatsu.description: Once locked on, there's no escape.\nThree players converge for this coordinated attack!
hissatsu.name: Sigma Zone

hissatsu.description: Dive down sharply from mid-air to kick the ball in\na curved arch.
hissatsu.name: Swallow Counter

hissatsu.description: From atop a sky-high tower,\ncall down lightning strikes onto the opposition,\nleaving them no chance even to cry out.
hissatsu.name: The Tower

hissatsu.description: Compress the player's energy along with the energy\nof a massive typhoon into the ball.
hissatsu.name: I Am the Almighty

hissatsu.description: All 11 players of the team combine powers to execute\na rainbow shot that makes the impossible possible.
hissatsu.name: Ultimate Eleven Assault

hissatsu.description: Two players use a large player's body as a springboard\nto combine Inazuma-1 and Inazuma Drop.
hissatsu.name: Inazuma-1 Drop

hissatsu.description: Dive towards the ball from mid-air and use the\nmomentum to slam it to the ground.
hissatsu.name: Power Spike

hissatsu.description: Three players charge the ball with thunder\nand launch it high for a lightning-like shot!
hissatsu.name: Inazuma Break

hissatsu.description: Spawn a forbidden fruit and shatter it,\nfusing creation and destruction in a single strike.
hissatsu.name: Scream of Eden

hissatsu.description: Conjure a small cyclone while rising into the air,\nusing the rotation to fire out a forceful shot.
hissatsu.name: Spin Meister

hissatsu.description: Forge the air into a bullet of wind,\nblast the foe away and steal the ball.
hissatsu.name: Ozone Flayer

hissatsu.description: Keep the ball under control at blinding speeds.\nPass by the opposition like lightning,\nleaving them thunderstruck.
hissatsu.name: Flash Dash

hissatsu.description: Run forward in a zigzag manner to start a fire\nwhile charging towards the opponent.
hissatsu.name: Zigzag Flame

hissatsu.description: Unleash a flurry of glittering ice and\nstop the ball in its tracks with dazzling force.
hissatsu.name: Icy Grace

hissatsu.description: An unpredictable shot that bounces off fragments of\nthe ground floating in the air.
hissatsu.name: Reflect Buster

hissatsu.description: Bury the ball in the ground and erupt it\nlike molten rock, crashing into the enemy goal.
hissatsu.name: Volcanic Rock

hissatsu.description: Shoot from the Triangle of Death.\nSynergy between the three players is highly important.
hissatsu.name: Death Zone

hissatsu.description: Sound a conch to summon a giant whale that devours\nopponents and the ball with its massive jaws.
hissatsu.name: Whale Guard

hissatsu.description: Stay hidden and strike from behind to ambush\nenemies before they notice what's happening.
hissatsu.name: Am-Bush

hissatsu.description: The ball is kicked high up\nand rockets to the goal like a missile.
hissatsu.name: Patriot Shot

hissatsu.description: Leap freely around the pitch, landing a fierce\nheel shot from above.
hissatsu.name: Parkour Power

hissatsu.description: Shout about a flying UFO\nto steal your foe's attention,\nthen sneak by with the ball in a cheeky dash.
hissatsu.name: Look! UFO

hissatsu.description: Summon a colossal foot from above to crush\ndefenders like a hammer of justice.
hissatsu.name: Divine Stamp

hissatsu.description: Channel draconic power into your legs\nand blast a fiery sidekick at the goal.
hissatsu.name: Dragon Cannon

hissatsu.description: Kick the ball and quickly follow up a few times to\nspeed the ball forward.
hissatsu.name: Ephemeral Boost

hissatsu.description:
Stir up a powerful typhoon to deliver a holy shot
that rampages through the pitch as it charges for
the goal.
hissatsu.name: Holy Roller

hissatsu.description: A super special move created by <FUL:DAISUKE>\nthat unites the will of all 11 players.
hissatsu.name: The Earth

hissatsu.description: Weave past defenders against the backdrop\nof a Silk Road sunset.
hissatsu.name: Silk Road

hissatsu.description: Create and control a giant hand shadow to catch the\nopponent's shadow by weaving through the ground.
hissatsu.name: Shadow Stitch

hissatsu.description: Scatter out sparks that explode violently!\nDazzle the opposition and make them cower.
hissatsu.name: Plasma Cut

hissatsu.description: Spinning in a flash of light, the ball is stolen\nin the blink of an eye, leaving opponents dazzled.
hissatsu.name: Photon Crash

hissatsu.description: Compress the player's energy along with the energy\nof a massive typhoon into the ball.
hissatsu.name: I Am the Almighty

hissatsu.description: Three players combine powers to summon\na Pegasus that rides to the goal from mid-air in a\nstormy hurricane.
hissatsu.name: Tri-Pegasus

hissatsu.description: Combine spinning Back and Fire Tornadoes\ninto a strike that swirls onward.
hissatsu.name: Double Tornado

hissatsu.description: A shot of pure darkness that possesses\ndesolating destructive power.\nThe black fog in its wake devours the pitch whole.
hissatsu.name: Black Ash

hissatsu.description: A fluffy and puffy dough shot that fills the pitch\nwith a toasty aroma.\n
hissatsu.name: Dough Ray Me

hissatsu.description: Bolt forward with two allies as an unstoppable\ntrio that barrels through defenders.
hissatsu.name: Triple Dash

hissatsu.description: Two players generate a rampaging cyclone that\nruthlessly blasts the opponent away.
hissatsu.name: Double Cyclone

hissatsu.description: Two players generate a rampaging cyclone that\nruthlessly blasts the opponent away.
hissatsu.name: Double Cyclone

hissatsu.description: Launch a flaming header that transforms into\na firebird, gliding fiercely toward the goal.
hissatsu.name: Flaming Firebird

hissatsu.description: Unleash the move using only your own strength in\na clone version of Emperor Penguin No. 2.
hissatsu.name: Clone Penguin

hissatsu.description: Smash the ground to fling opponents aside,\nthen crush them beneath six massive boulders.
hissatsu.name: Asterocks

hissatsu.description: Cross both arms to dash and lunge at the\nball, catching it in mid-air.
hissatsu.name: God Hand X

hissatsu.description: Like the Winter Triangle in the night sky, a shining\nbarrier of stars protects the goal.
hissatsu.name: Procyon Net

hissatsu.description: Gather atmospheric particles with a special method\nand use them to cause a big explosion on cue.
hissatsu.name: Particle Accelerator

hissatsu.description: Three players come together in a perfectly balanced\nmanner to unleash an eye-catching triangle shot.
hissatsu.name: Triangle ZZ

hissatsu.description: Shape your inner force into blazing sunlight and\ndrive the ball toward the goal in blinding light.
hissatsu.name: Solar Flex

hissatsu.description: Summon a spirit so fierce it grows a tail,\nthen whip it out in a wild, goal-seeking strike.
hissatsu.name: Dragon's Tail

hissatsu.description: Launch a maximum-power shot that turns\ninto a malevolent dragon, tearing through everything.
hissatsu.name: Last Resort D

hissatsu.description: Charge at the opponent like an ancient winged\ndinosaur swooping down with a cyclone in its wake.
hissatsu.name: Pterrordactyl Swoop

hissatsu.description: Pantomime at high speed to create multiple hand\nshapes that form a shield to block incoming shots.
hissatsu.name: Million Hands

hissatsu.description: A powerful special move that is a combination of\nDragon Crash and Fire Tornado.
hissatsu.name: Dragon Tornado

hissatsu.description: Ignite the ball into a blazing fireball and blast it\nacross the ground like a speeding bullet.
hissatsu.name: Daruma Boomer

hissatsu.description: Harness stealth technology to vanish and\nsnatch the ball unnoticed.
hissatsu.name: Stealth Step

hissatsu.description: Charge forward with a rabbit-like sprint and deliver\na springing kick full of flair.
hissatsu.name: Rabbit Run

hissatsu.description: Roll through the pitch wrapped in leaves,\ncrashing into opponents and taking them by surprise.
hissatsu.name: Trina Tumble

hissatsu.description: Gather electricity into a hand and release it all\nat once to put a quick stop to incoming shots.
hissatsu.name: Needle Hammer

hissatsu.description: Kick an ice-coated ball along an arcing path\nto freeze the opposition in their tracks.
hissatsu.name: Cold Snap

hissatsu.description: Summon a Great Wall from underground to surround\nand block the entire pitch.
hissatsu.name: Great Wall

hissatsu.description: Kick the ball using acrobatic moves to give it a\nsnake-like winding trajectory.
hissatsu.name: Sidewinder

hissatsu.description: Channel your aura into your toes and slash\nthrough the ball, slicing it clean\nwith a devastating strike.
hissatsu.name: Claw Slash

hissatsu.description: Link your resolve with two teammates and\nlaunch a shot powerful enough to shake the heavens.
hissatsu.name: Neo Galaxy

hissatsu.description: This chaotic strike that combines God Break with\nFire Blizzard destroys everything in its path.
hissatsu.name: Chaos Break

hissatsu.description: Gather dark matter from outer space around the ball\nand unleash hell on the opposing team's goalkeeper.
hissatsu.name: Dark Matter

hissatsu.description: Three players raise an impregnable infinite wall\ntogether in front of the goal.
hissatsu.name: Infinite Wall

hissatsu.description: A special move that ignites the ball with hellfire\nthrough a powerful kick.
hissatsu.name: Hellfire

hissatsu.description: Infuse willpower into your right hand to block goal\nshots by punching them away.
hissatsu.name: Fireball Knuckle

hissatsu.description: Block your target with force strong enough\nto stop even the fiercest bear.
hissatsu.name: Ursa Binder

hissatsu.description: Send the ball spinning sideways, bending through\nthe air in a clean banana-curve toward the goal.
hissatsu.name: Banana Shot

hissatsu.description: Summon a penguin huddle by whistling, and gather\nenergy as they circle around.
hissatsu.name: Emperor Penguin No. 3

hissatsu.description: Chop the ball with the force of an axe swing!\nEvery strike gets slammed to the ground.
hissatsu.name: Wood Chopper

hissatsu.description: Bounce the ball off a summoned card and\nangle it straight toward the goal in one swift trick.
hissatsu.name: Sweet Deal

hissatsu.description: Whip up a gust and blow opponents away\nin a whirlwind of festive fun.
hissatsu.name: Liar Shot

hissatsu.description: A special move that utilizes the flames blazing within.\nSynergy with the red-hot power of friendship\nfuels it further.
hissatsu.name: Fire Tornado DD

hissatsu.description: Headbutt the ball with blazing force and blast\nback any shot with explosive power.
hissatsu.name: Fireball Head

hissatsu.description: Use flower petals dancing daintily on the pitch to\nreduce the power of incoming shots.
hissatsu.name: Flower Power

hissatsu.description: Two players kick the ball to add a powerful spin\nthat conjures up a purple vortex and blows\nopponents away.
hissatsu.name: Field of Force

hissatsu.description: Faith in yourself summons a Pegasus.\nThis is the solo version of Tri-Pegasus.
hissatsu.name: Pegasus Shot

hissatsu.description: New version of Inazuma Drop where two players work\ntogether to execute a whirlwind bicycle kick.
hissatsu.name: Whirlwind Drop

hissatsu.description: Harness untamed speed and leap to seize\nthe ball with raw, primal force.
hissatsu.name: Wild Claw

hissatsu.description: Stand on the ball and roll it smoothly past\nopponents by making use of the momentum\nof the waves.
hissatsu.name: Log Roll

hissatsu.description: Generate a monstrous aura and overwhelm\nopponents with a horrifying blow.
hissatsu.name: Frankenstun

hissatsu.description: The ball burrows underground like a landmine and\nexplodes at the opponent's feet.
hissatsu.name: Blast Mine

hissatsu.description: Smash the ball with a full-power counter punch,\naiming for a game-changing rebound.
hissatsu.name: Counter Strike

hissatsu.description: Two extremely heightened powers fuse together to\ncreate the DNA of a new move.
hissatsu.name: The Dawn

hissatsu.description: Their moves may seem all over the place at first,\nbut it's all a calculated move to steal the ball.
hissatsu.name: Acrobotics

hissatsu.description: Synchronize with a teammate to release a sweeping\nshockwave that trips the opponent.
hissatsu.name: Aikido

hissatsu.description: Surround a fist with an icy aura before punching\nthe ball to freeze and stop it in an instant.
hissatsu.name: Ice Block

hissatsu.description: Behold the sharpness of an ancient blade!\nA shot that cuts straight through the pitch.
hissatsu.name: Katana Kick

hissatsu.description: Add a powerful spin to the ball by pinching it\nbetween both feet until it transforms into a\nspear-shaped shot.
hissatsu.name: Doom Spear

hissatsu.description: A swirling sandstorm sucks in the ball and weakens\nit enough to be caught.
hissatsu.name: Storm Rider

hissatsu.description: Mesmerize the opponent with a fantastic display of\nstardust and fireworks.
hissatsu.name: Oglitteration

hissatsu.description: A challenging dribble move where two players run in\nsync and carry the ball all the way to the goal.
hissatsu.name: Three-Legged Rush

hissatsu.description: Catch the ball firmly with a fist of fire.\nThe willpower contained within refuses to let the ball pass.
hissatsu.name: Combustion Catch

hissatsu.description: Unleash a flurry of glittering ice and\nstop the ball in its tracks with dazzling force.
hissatsu.name: Icy Grace

hissatsu.description: Spread your wings and strike from the sky with\nan overhead that slices through air to pierce the goal.
hissatsu.name: Celestial Saw

hissatsu.description: Electrocute nearby opponents with the spark of passion\nthat occurs from the friction of this zigzag dribble.
hissatsu.name: Zigzag Spark

hissatsu.description: Unleash prehistoric force with a shot that\nshakes the earth like a dinosaur's roar.
hissatsu.name: Dinosaur Roar

hissatsu.description: Three powerful kicks push the shot to evolve\nthe triple shot closer to its ultimate form.
hissatsu.name: Triple Threat

hissatsu.description: Summon a towering waterfall to block the\nopponent's path, embodying the grandeur of nature.
hissatsu.name: Waterfall

hissatsu.description: Charge the ball with overflowing cold and turn\nit into unbreakable ice that pierces the goal.
hissatsu.name: Polar Pike

hissatsu.description: Dash in with slicing speed, wrapped\nin the fury of a raging whirlwind.
hissatsu.name: Whirlwind Cut

hissatsu.description: Cover the goal with an array of infrared sensors\nto block every incoming shot.
hissatsu.name: Shot Trap

hissatsu.description: Form a seal and summon ghostly fire\nto unleash a circular blade shot.
hissatsu.name: Falling Planet

hissatsu.description: Summon a massive holographic arm to snatch\nand toss any defender in your way.
hissatsu.name: Holograb

hissatsu.description: Rise through multiple death zones and\nunleash a dark, searing blast toward Earth.
hissatsu.name: Final Death Zone

hissatsu.description: Whip up a ground-shaking tempest to blind\ndefenders and surge past.
hissatsu.name: Eye of the Storm

hissatsu.description: Passion ignites, exploding into a scorching storm\nthat burns all in its path.
hissatsu.name: Fireball Storm

hissatsu.description: Call forth swirling thunderclouds that imbue the\nball with electricity before shooting.
hissatsu.name: Thundertaker

hissatsu.description: Fix the target with a cold, cutting stare that\nknocks the fight right out of them.
hissatsu.name: Menacing Glare

hissatsu.description: Synchronize perfectly with your teammates and\nbarrel through defenders in a single, unstoppable line.
hissatsu.name: In-Line Stampede

hissatsu.description: Harness a dark, blood-charged power to launch\na monstrous shot bathed in moonlight.
hissatsu.name: Nocturne

hissatsu.description: Summon a scorching desert and crush your opponent\nbeneath a whirlwind of shifting sands to seize the ball.
hissatsu.name: Gravity Dune

hissatsu.description: Encase the ball in frigid air, driving it\ntoward the goal with the ferocity of a polar bear.
hissatsu.name: Polar Bear No. 2

hissatsu.description: Merge countless blue stars into a single streak\nof light racing across the pitch.
hissatsu.name: Starstruck

hissatsu.description: Cloak the ball in a raging blizzard and unleash\nursine forbidden might.
hissatsu.name: Icebreaker

hissatsu.description: Ride a giant ball with the Super Armadillo\nRodeo Clown and smash through enemies.
hissatsu.name: Armadillo Circus

hissatsu.description: Pour unwavering loyalty into the ball and fire it\nwith the precision of a devoted warrior.
hissatsu.name: Loyal Heart Shot

hissatsu.description: Spread both hands to summon a star-shaped\nbarrier and deflect the ball at comet-like speed.
hissatsu.name: All-Star

hissatsu.description: Unearth the treasures beneath the pitch\nand smash a dazzling, rock-breaking shot.
hissatsu.name: Gold Rush

hissatsu.description: Extend the ball like a rubber rope and use its\nelastic energy to blow the opponent away.
hissatsu.name: Bungee Ball Burst

hissatsu.description: Send the ball rocketing through the infinite\ngalaxy at breakneck speed.
hissatsu.name: Asteride

hissatsu.description: Wrap the ball in chaotic energy and hurl\nit like a devastating meteor.
hissatsu.name: Supermassive Shot

hissatsu.description: Bounce off giant mushrooms to leap over foes\nand scatter spores in your path.
hissatsu.name: Mushroom Hop

hissatsu.description: Spread a chaotic aura that erases everything\nin its path and sweep past opponents in style.
hissatsu.name: Format Disk

hissatsu.description: Command a swarm of eerie bats to\npaint the crescent sky blood-red.
hissatsu.name: Bloodsucker Bite

hissatsu.description: Draw light particles from the atmosphere into the ball,\nthen shoot a concentrated energy blast.
hissatsu.name: Atomic Spin

hissatsu.description: A delicate move for offence that uses an elegant display\nof rhythmic gymnastics\nto block the opposition's movements.
hissatsu.name: Hoopsie-Daisy

hissatsu.description: Strike a pose amid drifting cherry petals and\nfire a shot infused with kabuki spirit.
hissatsu.name: Kabuki Break

hissatsu.description: A giant white snake coils around the pitch and opens\nits jaws to swallow incoming shots whole.
hissatsu.name: Snakebite

hissatsu.description: Raise a shimmering wall of water with both hands\nand halt the shot in its tracks.
hissatsu.name: Silent Inkstroke

hissatsu.description: Drive the ball forward with a sharp, elephantine\nknee strike honed in Muay Thai.
hissatsu.name: Tusk Force

hissatsu.description: A blistering two-man Wrath Shot barrage that\nhammers the goal with relentless strikes.
hissatsu.name: Double Wrath Shot

hissatsu.description: This chaotic strike that combines God Break with\nFire Blizzard destroys everything in its path.
hissatsu.name: Chaos Break

hissatsu.description: Dive from above the goal and crush the ball\nwith a body slam to stop the shot.
hissatsu.name: Swan Dive

hissatsu.description: Kick the ball forward with both feet,\nin a move inspired by the kangaroo's jump.
hissatsu.name: Kangaroo Kick

hissatsu.description: Two players volley in unison to summon a unicorn\nthat charges straight for the goal.
hissatsu.name: Unicorn Boost

hissatsu.description: An emperor penguin born from darkness.\nIts aura of hate devours all.
hissatsu.name: Emperor Penguin X

hissatsu.description: Combine spinning Back and Fire Tornadoes\ninto a strike that swirls onward.
hissatsu.name: Double Tornado

hissatsu.description: Transform the ball into a surfboard that can be\nmounted and used to jump past opponents.
hissatsu.name: Air Ride

hissatsu.description: Summon a shimmering aurora before the goal,\ndulling every shot with majestic finesse.
hissatsu.name: Aurora Curtain

hissatsu.description: Create a large net that restricts\nthe opposition's movements.\nOnce caught, they are at the mercy of the hunter.
hissatsu.name: Hunter's Net

hissatsu.description: Dash at the speed of light, weaving across the\npitch to confuse opponents and snatch the ball.
hissatsu.name: Dynamic Dash

hissatsu.description: Send the opponent flying with a powerful impact wave\nlaunched by drawing a magic circle in the air.
hissatsu.name: Criss-Cross

hissatsu.description: Body slam the goalpost to make it slide away for a\nmiraculous save in this barely legal move.
hissatsu.name: Sliding Goal

hissatsu.description: This special move has three players working together\nto add explosive cosmic power to the shot.
hissatsu.name: Big Bang

hissatsu.description: A jumping side volley that summons a thunder beast.\nUsed to boost a teammate's shot.
hissatsu.name: Thunder Beast

hissatsu.description: The goalkeeper grows bigger by sheer willpower and\npunches the ball into the ground.
hissatsu.name: Gigant Wall

hissatsu.description: Trick the opponent with the illusion of a large\nfalling ball, causing them to recoil.
hissatsu.name: Big Ball Trick

hissatsu.description: Enveloped with an aura of death, the ball turns into\na weapon that exists only for destruction.
hissatsu.name: Doom Break

hissatsu.description: Focus while hopping from side to side to\nunleash an uppercut that negates incoming shots.
hissatsu.name: Flash Upper

hissatsu.description: Infuse the ball with electromagnetic power to make\nit spiral into the air together with the dribbler.
hissatsu.name: Tesla Coil

hissatsu.description: Manifest aurora lights and breeze past\nyour opponents while they're mesmerized.
hissatsu.name: Aurora Dribble

hissatsu.description: This move recreates the scene of an epic historical\nbattle on the pitch.
hissatsu.name: Okehazama Ravine

hissatsu.description: Use a mole fake that leaves the opponent guessing:\nwill the buried ball strike, or is it just an illusion?
hissatsu.name: Mole Shuffle

hissatsu.description: Call forth a blue Majin from your surging energy and\nseize every shot with all your might and unyielding heart.
hissatsu.name: Majin the Hand

hissatsu.description: The player stands tall with arms folded as a\nwhirlpool underfoot turns into a dragon and\nattacks the opponent.
hissatsu.name: Black Tide Ride

hissatsu.description: Rub the ball on the ground for friction to create a\nheated bouncing shot with unpredictable trajectory.
hissatsu.name: Bouncing Bomb

hissatsu.description: A ferocious snow leopard cuts through a\nblizzard to devour the goal.
hissatsu.name: Snowstorm Leopard

hissatsu.description: Dive into the turf, spinning to upend opponents\nand reclaim the ball from below.
hissatsu.name: Under Miner

hissatsu.description: Jump around the opponent like an agile monkey\nand slip past their defences.
hissatsu.name: Monkey Turn

hissatsu.description: Channel the rhythm and intensity of a perfect duo dance\ninto a dazzling, unstoppable shot.
hissatsu.name: Flash Dance

hissatsu.description: Guard the goal with a shield of flying cards in a\nhyper-dimensional card duel.
hissatsu.name: Card Protector

hissatsu.description: Strike at the perfect moment with an uppercut\nto block the ball and guard the goal.
hissatsu.name: Close Counter

hissatsu.description: Ride the ball at breakneck speed, dazzling\ndefenders with acrobatic flair.
hissatsu.name: Rodeo Clown

hissatsu.description: Call upon the beauty and lightning of the heavens\nto rock the earth and mark the dawn of a new myth.
hissatsu.name: God Alone Knows

hissatsu.description: The ball accelerates rapidly to the speed of sound\nimmediately after being kicked.
hissatsu.name: Sonic Shot

hissatsu.description: Save the goat kid that suddenly appears on the pitch\nby executing an Easy Breezy!
hissatsu.name: Easy Breezy Kid

hissatsu.description: Take a dazzling sword and swing with all your might.\nOnly one with a royal bearing can master this skill.
hissatsu.name: Sword of the King

hissatsu.description: A mournful strike, born of the fallen.\nOpponents glimpse a future in ruins.
hissatsu.name: No Future

hissatsu.description: Close your eyes to deliver a kick sharp enough to make\nthe petals of a chrysanthemum fall apart.\n
hissatsu.name: Chrysanthemum Katana

hissatsu.description: Send a blazing ball rolling to their feet and\nignite it in a burst at the perfect moment.
hissatsu.name: Burning Bomb

hissatsu.description: Gather the penguins' power into the ball,\nthen strike a fierce overhead toward the goal!
hissatsu.name: Penguin Volley

hissatsu.description: Gather the power of your allies into your right hand\nand defend the goal through friendship and belief.
hissatsu.name: God Hand of Friendship

hissatsu.description: Strike with fangs from every part of your body\nto hunt your prey in bestial style.
hissatsu.name: Savage Beast Fang

hissatsu.description: Kick the ball as it hovers through a\ndimensional rift with full power!
hissatsu.name: Dimensional Deluge

hissatsu.description: Mix a blizzard and storm together to generate an\nultra-destructive hurricane shot.
hissatsu.name: The Hurricane

hissatsu.description: Two players deliver perfectly-timed kicks in unison\nthat greatly increase the ball's conductivity.
hissatsu.name: Twin Sun Smash

hissatsu.description: Roar to summon a triceratops and stop\nthe shot with its crushing headbutt.
hissatsu.name: Tricera Stops

hissatsu.description: Feign a miss, then slice from behind with\nrazor-sharp water blades.
hissatsu.name: Jackknife

hissatsu.description: Shatter the ball into a cloud of sand that\nrains relentlessly toward the goal.
hissatsu.name: Dust Javelin

hissatsu.description: Hammer the opponent's shot with a full-force\nbasketball dunk.
hissatsu.name: Wild Dunk

hissatsu.description: Spin like a wheel and barrel across the pitch,\nknocking back every shot that comes your way.
hissatsu.name: Dust Devil

hissatsu.description: Command the ball's path mid-flight, curving it\nunpredictably to catch the keeper off-guard.
hissatsu.name: Orbital Drive

hissatsu.description: Raise teammates' dreams upon golden wings\nand seize victory as you unleash great power!
hissatsu.name: God Hand V

hissatsu.description: Channel force into a claw around your hand\nand shred the ball with fang-point precision.
hissatsu.name: Claw de Force

hissatsu.description: Sink the jaws of your mighty hand into the ball\nand tear it from the pitch with the\nferocity of a hunting beast.
hissatsu.name: Tiger God Hand

hissatsu.description: Charge forward as a trio, kicking up a cloud of dust\nand trampling opponents like raging bulls.
hissatsu.name: Bull Steam Ahead

hissatsu.description: Passion ignites, exploding into a scorching storm\nthat burns all in its path.
hissatsu.name: Fireball Storm

hissatsu.description: Summon a giant Moai statue from a rising mound\nto lift and hurl opponents far away.
hissatsu.name: Easter Island Header

hissatsu.description: Warp space to create a black hole that attracts all\nshots towards it.
hissatsu.name: Warp Space

hissatsu.description: A giant shark appears from among raging waves and\nattacks the opposing team's goalkeeper.
hissatsu.name: Megalodon

hissatsu.description: A blue dragon king spreads its wings and roars,\nunleashing a fierce yet majestic attack.
hissatsu.name: Dragon Slayer

hissatsu.description: Form a fist of pure aura energy\nand fire it to crush an oncoming shot.
hissatsu.name: Rocket Kobushi

hissatsu.description: The improved version of Rocket Kobushi that creates\ntwo fists of aura energy instead of just one.
hissatsu.name: Double Rocket

hissatsu.description: A trio of powerful kicks stokes roaring fire into\na mighty ground shot.
hissatsu.name: Grand Fire

hissatsu.description: Use crossed feet to cleave through the ball and\nlaunch it like a beam of light forged from sheer\nfighting spirit.
hissatsu.name: X Blast

hissatsu.description: Close your eyes to deliver a kick sharp enough to make\nthe petals of a chrysanthemum fall apart.\n
hissatsu.name: Chrysanthemum Katana

hissatsu.description: Absorb any shot with the softest part of the body\nand cushion the impact with mastery.
hissatsu.name: Utter Gutsiness Catch

hissatsu.description: A shot of pure darkness that possesses\ndesolating destructive power.\nThe black fog in its wake devours the pitch whole.
hissatsu.name: Black Ash

hissatsu.description: Apply backspin with a header and unleash\na flaming ball that rushes at the goal.
hissatsu.name: Hot Head

hissatsu.description: Launch skyward on a volcanic updraft and\nsnatch the ball while soaring at full speed.
hissatsu.name: Volcanic Flight

hissatsu.description: Focus all force at your fingertips to pierce\nand stop the ball in a single strike.
hissatsu.name: The Stinger

hissatsu.description: A powerful strike combining the Wyvern Crash\nand Eternal Blizzard.
hissatsu.name: Wyvern Blizzard

hissatsu.description: Slam the ground and use shockwave energy to call\nforth bulky rocks that protect the goal.
hissatsu.name: Fingers of Gaia

hissatsu.description: Unleash a beastly shot that bares its fangs\nat the goal, capable of felling even a bear.
hissatsu.name: Ursa Rager

hissatsu.description: Calculate the perfect angle and speed to\nintercept, turning every movement into a precise block.
hissatsu.name: Defence Equation

hissatsu.description: The ball is charged with energy that hails down\nlike a cold and unyielding rain.
hissatsu.name: Brimstone Rain

hissatsu.description: Block the opponent's offence with a wall of blazing\nflames swirling around your body.
hissatsu.name: La Flamme

hissatsu.description: A cosmic shot that crashes with heavenly force\nas a storm of stars fall from outer space.
hissatsu.name: Celestial Smash

hissatsu.description: A genuine love for football evolves the Majin into a\nmajestic guardian deity of goals.
hissatsu.name: God Catch

hissatsu.description: Stir up a strong cyclone and dive in, using the air\ntunnel to go right past the opponent.
hissatsu.name: Tornado Tunnel

hissatsu.description: Turn the pitch into a jungle as you swing three\nplayers into a simultaneous attack.
hissatsu.name: Jungle Jam

hissatsu.description: Leap from a towering height and descend\nin a blazing arc beneath the crimson sunset.
hissatsu.name: Skytree Hop

hissatsu.description: Use fiery hands to block incoming shots and\nreduce the ball to ashes.
hissatsu.name: Burnout

hissatsu.description: Accelerate to maximum speed using a teammate's punch\nand fly straight towards the goal, body and ball.
hissatsu.name: Warhead

hissatsu.description: Deadly special move that combines the power of\nFireball Storm and Tiger Drive.
hissatsu.name: Tiger Storm

hissatsu.description: Release whirlwinds from both hands and combine them\ninto one to absorb and negate incoming shots.
hissatsu.name: Whirlwind

hissatsu.description: Three powerful kicks push the shot to evolve\nthe triple shot closer to its ultimate form.
hissatsu.name: Triple Threat

hissatsu.description: Line up The Wall to block opponents' dribbles\nand turn into a moving fortress of defence.
hissatsu.name: Wall for One

hissatsu.description: Envelop the ball with a special barrier that\ngreatly reduces its power.
hissatsu.name: Shot Pocket

hissatsu.description: Mix a blizzard and storm together to generate an\nultra-destructive hurricane shot.
hissatsu.name: The Hurricane

hissatsu.description: The ball transforms into an RC car tire\nand cuts through the pitch directly to the goal!
hissatsu.name: RC Shot

hissatsu.description: Summon innumerable hands to shield the goal,\nimpeding all possible angles of approach.
hissatsu.name: Mugen the Hand

hissatsu.description: Two players close in on incoming shots from both\nsides in a perfectly timed combo block.
hissatsu.name: Dual Smash

hissatsu.description: Three players work together to conjure a cyclone\nthat boosts the destructive power of the shot that\nfollows.
