hissatsu.name: Jet Stream

hissatsu.description: A giant anchor hauled from underground hits\nincoming shots and sends them flying.
hissatsu.name: Anchors Aweigh

hissatsu.description: Combine forces with a teammate to unleash a\ndevastating blizzard-class shot that glimmers\nin silvery radiance.
hissatsu.name: Cold Front

hissatsu.description: Float like a boxer and snatch the ball\nwith flawless, nimble footwork.
hissatsu.name: Fancy-Footwork

hissatsu.description: Fire a rising burst of energy that splits into a\nstorm of arrows aimed straight at the keeper.
hissatsu.name: Entropic Arrows

hissatsu.description: Combine four elements into one for a destructive\nshot that surpasses them all.
hissatsu.name: Elemental Destroyer

hissatsu.description: Summon a tornado with three allies and send\ncloned balls hurtling at the goal from three directions.
hissatsu.name: Flying Colours

hissatsu.description: Wrap opponents in writhing pink vines, squeezing\nthem tight before slipping past.
hissatsu.name: Bindweed

hissatsu.description: Use good timing to grab the ball between both feet\nand redirect its trajectory.
hissatsu.name: Capoeira Grab

hissatsu.description: Send a jolt from your foot into your foe's body\nand snatch the ball when they freeze in shock.
hissatsu.name: Electric Impedance

hissatsu.description: A giant fist of justice protects the goal by\npunching away incoming shots.
hissatsu.name: Fist of Justice

hissatsu.description: Flip and smash the ball sky-high,\ndriving a full-force header home.
hissatsu.name: Headbanger

hissatsu.description: Light born from darkness turns into a destructive\nray in this move that unifies light and shadow.
hissatsu.name: Shadow Ray

hissatsu.description: Channel anger into energy to manifest a fearsome\nfiend.
hissatsu.name: Fiend Hand

hissatsu.description: Use the power of magnetism to draw the opponent's\nball away and hold on firmly to it.
hissatsu.name: Magnetism

hissatsu.description: Hammer the ball into a collection of hard shells and\nshoot it out as seven laser beams.
hissatsu.name: Shell Burst

hissatsu.description: Break their balance with a sharp feint, slicing\npast in a flash that traces a perfect Z.
hissatsu.name: Z Slash

hissatsu.description: Sweep every approaching shot aside with a colossal\niron fan infused with the power of a mighty dragon.
hissatsu.name: Fantastic Save

hissatsu.description: Summon multiple fake clones of the player and\nwalk right past the confused opponent.
hissatsu.name: Decoy Deploy

hissatsu.description: Surround both legs with a coil-like aura and send\nout a shot that pierces sharply like an arrow.
hissatsu.name: Double Helix

hissatsu.description: Slice through the clouds and unleash a\nsearing shot that blazes like the midsummer sun.
hissatsu.name: Solar Nexus

hissatsu.description: Erupt flames to form a blazing wall, scorching the ball\nand stopping every shot.
hissatsu.name: Burning Bulwark

hissatsu.description: Call forth radiant wings with magic, and streak past\nyour opponent with effortless grace.
hissatsu.name: Shiny Feathers

hissatsu.description: Drive your standard into the ground to call forth\na glowing sigil that sends enemies flying.
hissatsu.name: Marshal's Light

hissatsu.description: Block any and all shots with a giant right hand brimming\nwith passion for football.
hissatsu.name: Dreamscape: God Hand

hissatsu.description: Summon the Wind and Thunder Majin, covering\nblind spots and taking Majin the Hand to the next level.
hissatsu.name: Mega Majin

hissatsu.description: Spin the ball with both feet to generate a magnetic\nfield and launch a shot with unstoppable force.
hissatsu.name: Gaussian Goal

hissatsu.description: An evolution of God Hand that uses both hands,\nresulting in double the power.
hissatsu.name: Double God Hand

hissatsu.description: Three players charge the ball with thunder\nand launch it high for a lightning-like shot!
hissatsu.name: Inazuma Break

hissatsu.description: Encase the ball in boiling water, leaving\nthe keeper scorched if they dare to block it.
hissatsu.name: Bubble Trouble

hissatsu.description: Swing wide and punch the ball with full\nreach, stopping it in its tracks.
hissatsu.name: Twist 'n' Clout

hissatsu.description: Drive a towering strike into the earth\nand conjure a radiant sigil that repels\nevery incoming shot with majestic force.
hissatsu.name: Royal Shield

hissatsu.description: Passion ignites, exploding into a scorching storm\nthat burns all in its path.
hissatsu.name: Fireball Storm

hissatsu.description: Lure opponents into a massive labyrinth and\nslip past while they're lost in your cunning dribble.
hissatsu.name: Short Circuit

hissatsu.description: Unleash a miniature galaxy around the ball\nand crash it down toward the opponent's goal.
hissatsu.name: Galactic GigaFall

hissatsu.description: Deliver a series of powerful kicks to incoming shots\nthat make the ball burst apart.
hissatsu.name: Shot Stopper

hissatsu.description: Unleash a glowing projectile that swallows the ball,\nkills its momentum, and hurls it away.
hissatsu.name: Goal Gobbler

hissatsu.description: Shake the ground by stomping down from mid-air and\nsteal the ball from the opponent when they fall.
hissatsu.name: Earthquake

hissatsu.description: Descend like a hunting falcon and whip\nthe ball back in a dazzling, rapid strike.
hissatsu.name: Falcon Counter

hissatsu.description: Expand your aura and take on a gel-like form\nto absorb the force of every shot coming your way.
hissatsu.name: Wetsuit

hissatsu.description: Conjure storm clouds by kicking the ball up and zap\nthe opponent with strong electric shocks.
hissatsu.name: Ball Lightning

hissatsu.description: Two players join hands for this unison shot that\nbounces around the pitch like a herd of rabbits.\n
hissatsu.name: Splitting Hares

hissatsu.description: Passion ignites, exploding into a scorching storm\nthat burns all in its path.
hissatsu.name: Fireball Storm

hissatsu.description: Spin with the ball and strike a dizzying\nheader straight at the goal.
hissatsu.name: Gyro Head

hissatsu.description: Use gear motion to speed up the shot and give it an\nunpredictable trajectory.
hissatsu.name: Accelerator Gears

hissatsu.description: Cry out a tsunami of tears, engulfing the shot\nin a roaring emotional wave.
hissatsu.name: Flood of Feels

hissatsu.description: Take in the opponent's rhythm at a glance\nand shut down attacks with precision.
hissatsu.name: Defence Scan

hissatsu.description: Fire a laser beam from a military satellite\nat the ball to defend the goal.
hissatsu.name: Aegis Protocol

hissatsu.description: A sharp spin kick, causing an eruption of flames!\nThe wall of fire will blow away opponents and \nstop their breakthrough.
hissatsu.name: Volcano Cut

hissatsu.description: Three players' auras smash the ground apart.\nBall and boulder explode in a brutal strike.
hissatsu.name: Gaia Break

hissatsu.description: Let out a savage roar and strike from a cliff\nlike a shadowy beast under the full moon.
hissatsu.name: Werewolf Howl

hissatsu.description: Open a portal to outer space on the ground to\nunleash a shot surrounded by a lance-shaped aura.
hissatsu.name: Gungnir

hissatsu.description: An ice skating move that derives power\nfrom the conflicting nature\nbetween its gracefulness and freezing might.
hissatsu.name: Land of Ice

hissatsu.description: Combine forces with a teammate to unleash a\ndevastating blizzard-class shot that glimmers\nin silvery radiance.
hissatsu.name: Cold Front

hissatsu.description: A ferocious shark joins Emperor Penguin No. 2\nfor an epic showdown between two mighty champions!
hissatsu.name: Emperor Penguin No. 2 feat. Shark

hissatsu.description: Confuse the goalkeeper with a fierce bouncing shot\nfueled by the might of a giant ninja toad.
hissatsu.name: Ninja Toad

hissatsu.description: Dash atop the ball to accelerate it\nso it blasts for the goal with boosted speed.
hissatsu.name: Run Ball Run

hissatsu.description: Use a kick to create a tear in space that sucks in\nthe ball and reduces its power.
hissatsu.name: Vac Attack

hissatsu.description: Spiral into the sky with a dragon's fury and\nslam the ball down like a meteor.
hissatsu.name: Dragon Rage Dunk

hissatsu.description: Split the ball into two, strike with both feet,\nand fuse the two pieces back together\nto unleash a devastatingly powerful shot.
hissatsu.name: Fission and Fusion

hissatsu.description: Unleash a double strike, spinning the ball\nskyward and turning kicked-up dust into a\nraging surge of purple lightning.
hissatsu.name: Spring Thunderclap

hissatsu.description: Hurl a giant sand-arm uppercut and\nblast the ball away.
hissatsu.name: Sand Blaster

hissatsu.description: Charge headlong into the opponent with steam rising\nfrom the head like a raging runaway train.
hissatsu.name: Runaway Train

hissatsu.description: A powerful special move that is a combination of\nDragon Crash and Fire Tornado.
hissatsu.name: Dragon Tornado

hissatsu.description: Execute artistic mid-air somersaults to build\npower for an acrobatic shot.
hissatsu.name: Rolling Kick

hissatsu.description: Harness the unstoppable surge of oil to\nblast a thick, unstoppable shot at the goal.
hissatsu.name: Gusher Crusher

hissatsu.description: Spin like a top on the spot to create a gyroscopic\neffect that blunts the impact of incoming shots,\nmaking them easier to catch.
hissatsu.name: Gyro-Blocker

hissatsu.description: Execute a hair-raising roundhouse kick that sends\nout a diabolical shockwave.
hissatsu.name: Diabolical Cut

hissatsu.description: Analyze and profile the opponent's data to find an\nopening to steal the ball.
hissatsu.name: Perimeter Zone

hissatsu.description: Turn confidently away from the ball\nand pierce it with sharp aura thorns.
hissatsu.name: Rejection

hissatsu.description: Launch the ball to scatter a night sky of stars\nthat fall like meteors into the goal.
hissatsu.name: Stargazer

hissatsu.description: Two players move in perfect sync, unleashing\na powerful combo shot in a show of friendship.
hissatsu.name: Inazuma-1

hissatsu.description: Two players' auras cross and swirl violently,\nunleashing a stunningly powerful combo shot.
hissatsu.name: Cross Fire

hissatsu.description: Hit the ball with a heel to make it bounce off the\nground and into the opponent.
hissatsu.name: Heel Drop

hissatsu.description: The team's power crystallizes around the ball,\nand a dazzling twin shot shines forth.
hissatsu.name: Prime Legend

hissatsu.description: Howl like a silver wolf, the echo and your shot\nslicing through the moonlit night toward the goal.
hissatsu.name: Legendary Silver Wolf

hissatsu.description: Launch a towering shot that celebrates your triumph\nin a French twist on the legendary Steeple Shot.
hissatsu.name: Eiffel Tower

hissatsu.description: Spin the ball and scatter a cloud of toxic mist,\nblinding opponents in a whirlwind of chaos.
hissatsu.name: Dark Whirlwind

hissatsu.description: This double shot pits the opposing powers of ice\nand fire against each other to form a swirling\nvortex.
hissatsu.name: Fire Blizzard

hissatsu.description: Erect a circular barrier around you to create\nmyriad reflections and stop enemy attacks.
hissatsu.name: Containment Field

hissatsu.description: A barely legal move that makes use of a teammate's\nIllusory Ball to hit and blast opponents away.
hissatsu.name: Foul Offence 3

hissatsu.description: Harness the power of the earth to raise a wall,\nblocking the way and proving yourself a mighty defender.
hissatsu.name: Dreamscape: The Wall

hissatsu.description: The ball rises into the clouds and descends sharply,\nsurrounded by light, as if dealing out divine\npunishment.
hissatsu.name: Heavenly Drive

hissatsu.description: Shoot the ball at the goal while surrounded by\nwhirling flames that burn everything up instantly.
hissatsu.name: Fireball Screw

hissatsu.description: Transform into a colossal lion and snap at\nopponents to seize the ball.
hissatsu.name: Last Lion of Defence

hissatsu.description: Lift the opponent with the ball and blast them away\nwith a spinning kick in a mad, unstoppable strike.
hissatsu.name: Grand Slam

hissatsu.description: Kick the ball up and surround it with a dark aura\nbefore slamming it down for an overhead shot.
hissatsu.name: Doom Dive Drive

hissatsu.description: Surrounded by a cascade of stained glass,\nleap and shatter a crystal with a powerful strike.
hissatsu.name: Divine Drive

hissatsu.description: Add a strong backspin to the ball that enables the\nplayer to do a solo double touch.
hissatsu.name: Double Touch

hissatsu.description: Launch a dazzling fireworks display that\nmesmerizes both allies and foes alike.
hissatsu.name: Floral Fiesta

hissatsu.description: Pause time and gracefully bypass the defence.\nA natural aptitude is necessary to learn this move.
hissatsu.name: Heaven's Time

hissatsu.description: Polish the ball with a diamond-hardened kick\nto send it arcing just before the goal.
hissatsu.name: Diamond Cutter

hissatsu.description: Multicolored penguins form a mesmerizing rainbow arc\nas they swarm toward the goal.
hissatsu.name: Emperor Penguin 7

hissatsu.description: A foot suddenly juts out from a portal,\ncatching the opponent off guard.
hissatsu.name: Spatial Portal

hissatsu.description: Soar high into the sky, spot your target and unleash\na bullet-like shot that dives toward the goal.
hissatsu.name: Avenging Eagle

hissatsu.description: This ultimate shot reduces everything to nothingness\nby blending light and darkness together.
hissatsu.name: Zero Magnum

hissatsu.description: Team up to spin like a saw, slicing across the pitch\nand barreling past all in your path.
hissatsu.name: Warsaw

hissatsu.description: Channel the power of a mighty dragon into your\nfoot and strike with a sharp, roaring shot.
hissatsu.name: Heavenly Tianlong

hissatsu.description: Combine sharp calculation and keen insight\nto orchestrate a flawless, unstoppable defence.
hissatsu.name: Logicstical Sync

hissatsu.description: Conjure a steel-bound fortress to fire volleys\nof cannonballs and sweep your opponents aside.
hissatsu.name: The Stronghold

hissatsu.description: Envelop your foe in a curse to slow them,\nthen dash right past.
hissatsu.name: Black Magic

hissatsu.description: A conducted shot of orchestral magnificence\nthat is accompanied by an exquisite melody.
hissatsu.name: Fortissimo

hissatsu.description: A long shot which pierces like a spear\nretaining the spirits of past rulers.\nA divine demonstration of majesty.
hissatsu.name: Royal Lancer

hissatsu.description: Call a great hero forth whose heart of justice\ndrives the ball straight toward the goal.
hissatsu.name: Perseus Strike

hissatsu.description: Stretch the ball out to its limits, and use the\nelastic energy to fire a high-speed shot.
hissatsu.name: Slingshot

hissatsu.description: Open a tiny black hole and dash through\nwarp space to reappear ahead.
hissatsu.name: Warp Drive

hissatsu.description: A powerful strike combining the Wyvern Crash\nand Eternal Blizzard.
hissatsu.name: Wyvern Blizzard

hissatsu.description: Opposing fire and ice crash into one\nto form a swirling vortex double strike.
hissatsu.name: Fire Blizzard

hissatsu.description: Trigger an explosion at your feet, masking your\nadvance in a cloud of smoke.
hissatsu.name: Bewilder Blast

hissatsu.description: Send the ball surging through a blazing storm,\nricocheting off fire orbs to unleash its\nfull energy on the goal.
hissatsu.name: Cheat Blaster

hissatsu.description: The ball turns into a weapon of destruction that\nrains down crimson rays of death.
hissatsu.name: Doom Rain

hissatsu.description: A mesmerizing illusion shot where a mirage\nmakes it look like the ball splits into two.
hissatsu.name: Mirage Shot

hissatsu.description: Rain down a massive meteor from the sky,\nblanketing the ground in shock and flame.
hissatsu.name: Red Hot Shower

hissatsu.description: Scan the opponent and instantly calculate the best\nroute to dribble around them.
hissatsu.name: Future Eye

hissatsu.description: The ball dodges and confuses the opponent as if it\nhas a will of its own.
hissatsu.name: Dog Run

hissatsu.description: Add spin to the ball using fancy footwork and shoot\nto a Samba beat.
hissatsu.name: Samba Strike

hissatsu.description: Build up a daunting Japanese-style fortress in the\nblink of an eye, intimidating the opponent.
hissatsu.name: Overnight Fortress

hissatsu.description: Trap the ball against your opponent's chest\nand punt both away in one ruthless strike.
hissatsu.name: Foul Offence

hissatsu.description: Call forth a twin-headed eagle to strike and\nunleash a shot of devastating power.
hissatsu.name: Regal Eagle

hissatsu.description: Jump higher than anyone on the pitch and shoot at\nthe goal with full power from mid-air.\n
hissatsu.name: Jumping Jack

hissatsu.description: Soul-like orbs gather together in this mysterious\nattack that surpasses human understanding.
hissatsu.name: Will-o'-the-Wisp Shot

hissatsu.description: Harness the raw fury of a swirling tornado\nto deliver a rough but devastating shot.
hissatsu.name: Brawl of the Wild

hissatsu.description: Merge countless shields into a single fortress,\ndeflecting shots from every direction.
hissatsu.name: Diamond Igloo

hissatsu.description: Trade lightning-fast passes until the ball\nlooks like it's multiplied mid-dribble.
hissatsu.name: Dual Pass

hissatsu.description: Levitate the opponent with the ball and\nhurl both away with telekinetic force.
hissatsu.name: Psychic Lift

hissatsu.description: Unite elite forces into the ball to form a flawless\npenguin that rushes straight for the goal.
hissatsu.name: Perfect Penguin

hissatsu.description: Curl up like an armadillo and rapidly spin forward,\nclutching the football while crashing through opponents.
hissatsu.name: Super Armadillo

hissatsu.description: Shoot the ball at the goal while surrounded by\nwhirling flames that burn everything up instantly.
hissatsu.name: Fireball Screw

hissatsu.description: Divine and demonic penguins converge on the ball,\ncreating a force of opposites beyond measure.
hissatsu.name: Penguin Reckoning

hissatsu.description: Two jumbo-sized players approach from behind and\nput a stop to any player sandwiched between them.
hissatsu.name: Jumbo Sandwich

hissatsu.description: Unleash a full-power shot with devastating force\ncapable of splitting the heavens and rending the earth.
hissatsu.name: Crack Shot

hissatsu.description: Wrap the ball in chaotic energy and hurl\nit like a devastating meteor.
hissatsu.name: Supermassive Shot

hissatsu.description: Leap into an unknown space from the field to boost\npower and execute a shot from beyond known dimensions.
hissatsu.name: Dark Energy Star

hissatsu.description: Two players unleash simultaneous middle kicks,\nknocking opponents back with a shockwave.
hissatsu.name: Center Scythe Slice

hissatsu.description: Send the ball streaking like a meteor to produce\na supernova-level strike of unimaginable power.
hissatsu.name: Cosmic Blaster

hissatsu.description: A high level ninja move that confuses the opponent\nby splitting into three fast-moving ninja clones.
hissatsu.name: Clone Faker

hissatsu.description: Drop kick the ball with both feet for double the\npower and send it flying like a rapid bullet.
hissatsu.name: Double Grenade

hissatsu.description: Mesmerize the opponent with a fantastic display of\nstardust and fireworks.
hissatsu.name: Oglitteration

hissatsu.description: Gather evil energies into the ball and shoot from up high.\nThe sheer impact can bring ruin to the entire pitch.
hissatsu.name: Disaster Strike

hissatsu.description: Send the ball arcing past everyone in diamond-bright\nglory to catch the keeper off guard.
hissatsu.name: Arced Diamond Ray

hissatsu.description: Smother any shot with raw, sheer guts,\npunching it straight back.
hissatsu.name: Gutsy Grit Punch

hissatsu.description: Those who are caught by these ghostly hands that\nappear from the ground can never escape.
hissatsu.name: Ghost Pull

hissatsu.description: Quickly draw close to the opponent and\nsteal the ball before they know what hit them.
hissatsu.name: Quick Draw

hissatsu.description: Turn with effortless grace, holding the ball\nas you captivate the pitch with\na picture-perfect flourish.
hissatsu.name: Frost Finesse

hissatsu.description: Merge three beings into one and behold the great Majin's\ndescent, six arms ready to stop any incoming shot.
hissatsu.name: Majin Merge

hissatsu.description: Fuse light and dark auras into a shot\nof unstoppable, amplified force.
hissatsu.name: Great Blaster

hissatsu.description: Soar over the opponent and bound lightly\nthrough the air while advancing forward.
hissatsu.name: Dance on Air

hissatsu.description: Sharpened focus summons freezing snow and\nconjures up a blizzard at the goal area.
hissatsu.name: Eternal Blizzard

hissatsu.description: A blistering two-man Wrath Shot barrage that\nhammers the goal with relentless strikes.
hissatsu.name: Double Wrath Shot

hissatsu.description: Split into three and send one person to attack while\nthe other two steal the ball.
hissatsu.name: Clone Defence

hissatsu.description: Narrow your defensive range and focus your power\nto strengthen God Hand even further.
hissatsu.name: Super God Hand

hissatsu.description: Call forth a water demon of unyielding spirit that\nsweeps every shot away in a violent torrent.
hissatsu.name: Majin the Wave

hissatsu.description: Combine The Wall with God Hand\nto block charging enemies like a dam.
hissatsu.name: Stone Wall

hissatsu.description: A double kick opens up a dimension to outer space\nand the energy is harnessed for a shot of cosmic\nstrength.
hissatsu.name: Cosmic Blast

hissatsu.description: The strongest shot in all of El Dorado's arsenal.\nA myriad of aspects converge to\nform a dazzling rainbow beam.
hissatsu.name: Omega Assault

hissatsu.description: Unleash a swirling onslaught of draconic energy\nin a single, powerful burst.
hissatsu.name: Dragon Drive

hissatsu.description: Dive into the shot and split the ball in two\nwith a brutal elbow.
hissatsu.name: Menace Elbow

hissatsu.description: Conjure a whirlpool strong enough to sink ships and\nsteal the ball after the opponent is swept up in the\nwaves.
hissatsu.name: Whirlpool

hissatsu.description: Banish even the laws of the universe into oblivion.\nThis overwhelming power is nothing short of a divine act.
hissatsu.name: God Knows

hissatsu.description: Unleash a raging hurricane from the ball\nand send it barreling toward the goal.
hissatsu.name: Twister Tornado

hissatsu.description: Leap skyward with the power of your allies and\nsmash the ball down in a meteor-like overhead strike.
hissatsu.name: Meteor Strike

hissatsu.description: Leap up and dive sharply headfirst toward the ball,\nlike a condor aiming for prey.
hissatsu.name: Condor Dive

hissatsu.description: Kick to spin the ball and reel it back\nlike a tethered yo-yo.
hissatsu.name: Yo-Yo Ball

hissatsu.description: Rocket the ball sky-high and blast it past the\natmosphere and across the galaxy.
hissatsu.name: We Have Liftoff!

hissatsu.description: Radiate the presence of a giant and halt attackers\nwith sheer, undeniable authority.
hissatsu.name: Mega Wall

hissatsu.description: Use a forbidden technique to summon penguins that\nbite your arms, boosting your catching power.
hissatsu.name: Penguin the Hand

hissatsu.description: Send the ball through a magic circle and blast\nit forward with explosive, amplified power.
hissatsu.name: Magic Amp

hissatsu.description: Deliver a series of frenzied kicks to the ball\nbefore unleashing a super shot from mid-air.
hissatsu.name: Wrath Shot

hissatsu.description: Rain the ball down like a blazing comet,\nleaving a trail of light in its wake.
hissatsu.name: Comet Shot

hissatsu.description: Launch an airborne ball with a lethal bicycle strike,\ninspired by the Doomsword Slash move.
hissatsu.name: Bicycle Slash

hissatsu.description: Invert everything in the world and change the\ndirection of incoming shots.
hissatsu.name: Negative Feedback

hissatsu.description: Freeze the opponent into a giant ice block using\nsnow crystals born from frigid winds.
hissatsu.name: Snow Angel

hissatsu.description: Feign left and right in quick succession\nto leave the opponent at their wit's end.
hissatsu.name: Hey Presto

hissatsu.description: Execute a series of backflips with the ball against\na moonlit sky, ending with a perfect moonsault.
hissatsu.name: Ultra Moon

hissatsu.description: Analyze the keeper's every move and strike\nthe ball along the perfect path to the goal.
hissatsu.name: Solution Boost

hissatsu.description: The cosmic energy and the hunger to win\ncombine to form a cross-shaped explosion\nthat blows away the opposition.
hissatsu.name: Southern Cross

hissatsu.description: Transform a ball surrounded by dark aura into a\nphoenix to amplify its original power.
hissatsu.name: Dark Phoenix

hissatsu.description: Crouch down like a predator hunting prey until the\nillusion of a tiger can be seen behind the player.
hissatsu.name: Tiger Drive

hissatsu.description: A wild dance too fast for the naked eye to perceive!\nTrap the opposition in a violent vortex.
hissatsu.name: Wind God's Dance

hissatsu.description: Channel raw force into the airborne ball\nand fire it at the goal in a brilliant flash of\nswirling fuchsia energy.
hissatsu.name: Force Flash

hissatsu.description: Take in the opponent's rhythm at a glance\nand slip past the defence with precision.
hissatsu.name: Attack Scan

hissatsu.description: Launch a shot of unfathomable power that transforms\ninto a dragon, thrashing toward the goal.
hissatsu.name: Last Resort

hissatsu.description: Three players work together to trap the opponent\ninside an eerie fractal house.
hissatsu.name: Fractal Repeller

hissatsu.description: Pursue the ball in a chariot and unleash\na follow-up kick with the force of galloping horses.
hissatsu.name: Twin Gallop

hissatsu.description: Rain down blinding lights as intense as lasers,\nmaking the opposition falter in awe.
hissatsu.name: Solar Surprise

hissatsu.description: Summon a penguin huddle by whistling, and gather\nenergy as they circle around.
hissatsu.name: Emperor Penguin No. 3

hissatsu.description: Spin the ball to generate a cyclone that kicks up\ndirt to blind the opponent.
hissatsu.name: Whirlwind Twister

hissatsu.description: Twist and flip like a gymnast, vaulting clean\nover your opponent's head.
hissatsu.name: Moonsault

hissatsu.description: Dance to a savage samba rhythm and\nsweep past the keeper with a deadly flourish.
hissatsu.name: Beyond the Sambadrome

hissatsu.description: Step into a dance and strike the ball to send\nit spinning fiercely into the net.
hissatsu.name: Capoeira Kick

hissatsu.description: Launch a triple Fire Tornado with three blazing\nspirals that crash together into one brutal shot.
hissatsu.name: Fire Tornado TC

hissatsu.description: Fuse light and dark auras into a shot\nof unstoppable, amplified force.
hissatsu.name: Great Blaster

hissatsu.description: Execute an elegant dance that tempts the opponent\nto dance along.
hissatsu.name: Prima Donna

hissatsu.description: Deadly special move that combines the power of\nFireball Storm and Tiger Drive.
hissatsu.name: Tiger Storm

hissatsu.description: Harness gravity to turn the ball into a weight\nand swing defenders around like ragdolls.
hissatsu.name: Heavy Mettle

hissatsu.description: Harden your arm into diamond to snatch the ball\nwith a technique both rigid and remarkably fluid.
hissatsu.name: Diamond Arm

hissatsu.description: Summon countless undead arms from the depths\nto devour the ball in a terrifying display.
hissatsu.name: Shadow Shield

hissatsu.description: Summon a colossal planet overhead and crush\nopponents with a cosmic-scale strike.
hissatsu.name: Planet Shield

hissatsu.description: Who cares if your glasses break? It's worth it\nif it makes the ball change trajectory!
hissatsu.name: Spectacle Crash

hissatsu.description: Kick the ball and quickly follow up a few times to\nspeed the ball forward.
hissatsu.name: Ephemeral Boost

hissatsu.description: The bond of friendship between two players stirs up\nvictorious winds of change.
hissatsu.name: Revolution V

hissatsu.description: Feel your pulse quicken and break through\nat the speed of sound,\nleaving defenders dumbfounded in their tracks.
hissatsu.name: Heart Beat

hissatsu.description: Summon swirling waves that coalesce and form\na colossal hand to reel in incoming shots.
hissatsu.name: Maelstrom the Hand

hissatsu.description: Three players form a circle and all slide in at once\ntrapping your rival like a bird in a cage.
hissatsu.name: Bamboo Pattern

hissatsu.description: Analyze, plan, and strike to execute a\nbrainy dribble that bends the pitch to your will.
hissatsu.name: Matrix Eye

hissatsu.description: Deliver a sharp kick that stirs up a cyclone around\nthe opponent and carries them, ball and all,\ninto the air.
hissatsu.name: Cyclone

hissatsu.description: Merge countless shields into a single fortress,\ndeflecting shots from every direction.
hissatsu.name: Diamond Igloo

hissatsu.description: Wrap opponents in the ball's strange, hypnotic\nmelody and slip past while they're distracted.
hissatsu.name: Fugue Wave

hissatsu.description: Ride a massive wave and perform an impressive long shot\nthat rips through the water toward the goal.
hissatsu.name: Tsunami Boost

hissatsu.description: Sprinkle a dreamy scent to lull foes into\ndeep sleep and seize the ball.
hissatsu.name: Sleeping Dust

hissatsu.description: Manifest a rock hand in a space reminiscent of an\nink painting to put a stop to incoming shots.
hissatsu.name: Song of the Three Kingdoms

hissatsu.description: Harry the opposition with\na merciless roar borne from a dragon's might.
hissatsu.name: Dragon Crash

hissatsu.description: A barely legal move that uses ninja clones to kick\nthe ball from three different angles.
hissatsu.name: Clone Shot

hissatsu.description: Suck in lungfuls of air and puff your chest\nto reflect away incoming shots.
hissatsu.name: Breath Taker

hissatsu.description: Unleash a mighty punch that shakes the ground,\nstopping everything in its path.
hissatsu.name: Ground Quake

hissatsu.description: Snap your arms together like a crocodile\nto clamp down and snatch the ball.
hissatsu.name: Crocodile Crush

hissatsu.description: Do a thorough scan to read the opponent's next\nmove and steal the ball from them.
hissatsu.name: Thief's Eye

hissatsu.description: The ball rolls along the ground and builds power,\nturning into a crushing dirt ball strike.
hissatsu.name: Dirt Ball

hissatsu.description: Three players come together to create a combo shot\nwith a Z-shaped trajectory.
hissatsu.name: Triangle Z

hissatsu.description: Two players use a large player's body as a springboard\nto combine Inazuma-1 and Inazuma Drop.
hissatsu.name: Inazuma-1 Drop

hissatsu.description: Imprison the opponent with stone pillars from the\nground and steal the ball from them.
hissatsu.name: Stone Prison

hissatsu.description: Raise a stone gate on the pitch, steel bars\nhalting every attack on goal.
hissatsu.name: Bastion Block

hissatsu.description: Twist elongated energy into spaghetti-like strands,\nwrap them around your arm, and deliver an uppercut.
hissatsu.name: Marinara Barrier

hissatsu.description: A large foot appears in the sky and stomps on the\nopponent in this enhanced version of Sumo Stomp.
hissatsu.name: Super Sumo Stomp

hissatsu.description: A combo move that works together with Fire Tornado\nby boosting its power.
hissatsu.name: Twin Boost F

hissatsu.description: Two players form a whirling wheel and slam\ninto opponents, sending them flying.
hissatsu.name: Rolling Hell

hissatsu.description: Tear across the pitch like a dragon devouring\nthe earth on its way to the goal.
hissatsu.name: Land Dragon

hissatsu.description: Jump above the opponent to distract them while\nanother player steals the ball.
hissatsu.name: Circus Block

hissatsu.description: Tap into your resolve, tempered by countless trials,\nto form a colossal crimson hand and guard the goal.
hissatsu.name: God Hand

hissatsu.description: Manifest a rock hand in a space reminiscent of an\nink painting to put a stop to incoming shots.
hissatsu.name: Song of the Three Kingdoms

hissatsu.description: Step and pivot with power to create a whirlwind\nthat knocks enemies off their feet.
hissatsu.name: Peaky Breezy

hissatsu.description: Spread a spider web on the ground that makes\nmovement difficult.
hissatsu.name: Spider Web

hissatsu.description: Draw a royal crest in the air to unleash your determination\nand defend the goal at all costs.
hissatsu.name: Force Shield

hissatsu.description: Accelerate past defenders at warp speed,\nleaving even sprinters in the dust.
hissatsu.name: Warp Step

hissatsu.description: An ultimate technique, developed as an improvement\nfor Death Zone. When three personalities collide,\nimmense power is unleashed.
hissatsu.name: Death Zone 2

hissatsu.description: Kick the ball up with your knee and\nhammer it down with a sharp heel kick.
hissatsu.name: Heel Kick

hissatsu.description: Dive beneath the waves and dance like a mermaid,\nwrapping the ball in a veil of water to stop it.
hissatsu.name: Mermaid's Veil

hissatsu.description: Confound foes with an eerie double that\nblocks in your place.
hissatsu.name: Doppelganger

hissatsu.description: Blast the goal with an explosive overhead kick\nthat shakes the net.
hissatsu.name: Dynamite Shot

hissatsu.description: Summon a glowing hole that swallows the ball\nand banishes it to another dimension.
hissatsu.name: White Hole

hissatsu.description: Manifest a shield infused with barbarian strength\nto intimidate and repel any assault.
hissatsu.name: Barbarian Shield

hissatsu.description: Barrel through defenders with a crushing tackle\nto flatten everything in your path.
hissatsu.name: Road Roller

hissatsu.description: Unleash energy blades in a cross-shape and use them\nto hit incoming shots away.
hissatsu.name: Crescent Cross

hissatsu.description: Twist the body to build power and drive it into the\nball all at once for a knockout special move.
hissatsu.name: Grenade Shot

hissatsu.description: Grab a teammate to use as a bat in an ultimate show of\nmutual trust.
hissatsu.name: Utter Gutsiness Bat

hissatsu.description: Send the ball streaking like a meteor to produce\na supernova-level strike of unimaginable power.
hissatsu.name: Cosmic Blaster

hissatsu.description: Overtake the opponent using high-speed backflips and\nsteal the ball with a sliding tackle.
hissatsu.name: Rolling Slide

hissatsu.description: Teleport the shooter in front of their own shot,\nforcing them to block it with their body.
hissatsu.name: Dark Reversal

hissatsu.description: Ignite your fist in a scorching blast and\nfry the ball to dust.
hissatsu.name: Burnout Burst

hissatsu.description: Unleash a barrage of attack cards in a\nhyper-dimensional football clash,\nstopping opponents in their tracks.
hissatsu.name: Card Shark

hissatsu.description: Two players kick the ball with full force and make\nit fly towards the goal as if with fiery wings.
hissatsu.name: Fire Rooster

hissatsu.description: Dive beneath the surface like a submarine, reading\nthe opponent's movements as you break through.
hissatsu.name: Sub-Terfuge

hissatsu.description: Execute a sprint start on cue to achieve maximum\nspeed in a split second.
hissatsu.name: Dragster

hissatsu.description: A noble aura engulfs the player's raised right foot,\nforming a massive blade that cleaves the field.
hissatsu.name: Excalibur

hissatsu.description: Legendary wings sprout against the sun and the\nbright light that results blinds the opponents,\nallowing for a breakthrough.
hissatsu.name: The Ikaros

hissatsu.description: Spin the ball into a spiraling tempest that\ntwists and turns to catch the keeper\ncompletely off guard.
hissatsu.name: Swirly Shot

hissatsu.description: Soar with the grace of a marlin and\ndrive the ball in a razor-sharp strike.
hissatsu.name: Flying Marlin

hissatsu.description: An overhead strike sends the ball crashing down,\nraining to earth like a blazing meteor.
hissatsu.name: Meteor Shower

hissatsu.description: Three players run in a straight line and kick the\nball to the one ahead to create a triple-boosted\nlong shot.
hissatsu.name: Triple Boost

hissatsu.description: Cloak the ball in a raging blizzard and unleash\nursine forbidden might.
hissatsu.name: Icebreaker

hissatsu.description: Summon a mighty being that blasts forth\na beam from its mouth at enemies.
hissatsu.name: Master Stroke

hissatsu.description: Buffet the opposition into disarray with\nspeed like the wind!\nCan only be mastered by lightweight players.
hissatsu.name: Flurry Dash

hissatsu.description: Unleash a toxic mist to stagger opponents\nand dash through the opening.
hissatsu.name: Poison Fog

hissatsu.description: Drag foes into the depths in a swirling plunge\nand snatch the ball with relentless force.
hissatsu.name: Deep Diver

hissatsu.description: Split the ball into five parts and send them flying\ntoward the keeper in a dazzling display.
hissatsu.name: Flurry-Go-Round

hissatsu.description: Kick in sync with a shot clad in ice to drive a\ncolossal lance of darkness straight into the net.
hissatsu.name: Beyond the Death Zone

hissatsu.description: Strike alongside a shadowy double in a high-speed\ntwin shot that hits with double power.
hissatsu.name: Orion's Shade

hissatsu.description: Inflate the ball like a giant bubble and burst it\nto blast defenders away.
hissatsu.name: Bubble Gum

hissatsu.description: Charge ahead while generating a whirlwind and\nblast approaching opponents into the sky.
hissatsu.name: Dash Storm

hissatsu.description: Split the ball and drill through with a glowing,\nhigh-intensity combination strike.
hissatsu.name: Double-Trouble

hissatsu.description: Whirl into action with astonishing speed and\ndance through opponents to claim the ball.
hissatsu.name: Twirling Turtle

hissatsu.description: Apply pressure on the ball to bury it and charge\nforward underground like an actual mole.
hissatsu.name: Mole Fake

hissatsu.description: Soup up the sauce with overflowing energy\nto supercharge the spaghetti strike to new heights.
hissatsu.name: Sauced-up Marinara Barrier

hissatsu.description: The God Hand evolves into its ultimate form\nto catch and crush any shot with ease.
hissatsu.name: Omega Hand

hissatsu.description: Soar beyond the atmosphere and send\na star-shattering strike crashing downward.
hissatsu.name: Starstriker

hissatsu.description: Two players slide in to trap the opponent\nlike crabs brandishing their claws.
hissatsu.name: Pincer Pinch

hissatsu.description: A ferocious shark joins Emperor Penguin No. 2\nfor an epic showdown between two mighty champions!
hissatsu.name: Emperor Penguin No. 2 feat. Shark

hissatsu.description: Freeze the ball in an instant using a beautiful\ncrystal-like ice barrier.
hissatsu.name: Crystal Barrier

hissatsu.description: Smash the ground with a colossal steel strike\nto send a violent tremor that scatters your opponents.
hissatsu.name: Metal Hammer

hissatsu.description: Tackle the opposition head-on\nby using one's burning fighting spirit as armor.
hissatsu.name: Scorching Tackle

hissatsu.description: The South Pacific Ocean appears before the goal and\nits currents weaken the strength of incoming shots.
hissatsu.name: Barrier Reef

hissatsu.description: Unleash a souped-up Flurry Dash and blaze\npast opponents in a streak of fire.
hissatsu.name: Gale Dash

hissatsu.description: Halt the ball in time with mysterious power\nand strike at the perfect moment.
hissatsu.name: Time Trance

hissatsu.description: Smash a graceful overhead shot from\nthe top of the looming tower.
hissatsu.name: Off-Balance Pisa Kick

hissatsu.description: Burst forward at astonishing speed,\nleaving a trail that flashes like lightning.
hissatsu.name: Lightning Bolt

hissatsu.description: Envelop your hand in a rainbow wave with the\nultimate evolution of God Hand to block any shot.
hissatsu.name: God Hand EV

hissatsu.description: Imbue the ball with the glowing prayers of the goddess,\nturning strong resolve into pure power.
hissatsu.name: Luminous Orb

hissatsu.description: Strike the opponent with three relentless rising\nkicks with this deadlier version of Pyrokinetic.
hissatsu.name: Pyroclastic

hissatsu.description: Descend from above to punch the ball down,\ncrushing any shot in your path.
hissatsu.name: Pressure Punch

hissatsu.description: Three players form a circle and all slide in at once\ntrapping your rival like a bird in a cage.
hissatsu.name: Bamboo Pattern

hissatsu.description: Slash down with a scythe-like aura,\ncleaving every shot in two.
hissatsu.name: Killer Blade

hissatsu.description: Launch a blazing ball with a somersault kick\nstraight into the opponent's jaw.
hissatsu.name: Pyrokinetic

hissatsu.description: Execute a shot that bites into the opposing team's\ngoal like a tyrannosaurus biting into its prey.
hissatsu.name: Jurassic Jaws

hissatsu.description: Unleash a skybound penguin procession to guide\nthe ball with precise, whimsical power toward the net.
hissatsu.name: Royal Penguin Parade

hissatsu.description: Launch penguins equipped with spacesuits off into space,\nwho'll reenter the atmosphere and go for the goal!
hissatsu.name: Space Penguin

hissatsu.description: Manifest a black hole in your palm to attract and\ncatch incoming shots.
hissatsu.name: Black Hole

hissatsu.description: Keep opponents away by creating a barrier using\nwater that spurts out from the ground.
hissatsu.name: Water Veil

hissatsu.description: Pull opponents into another dimension and\nshatter their focus with a single, haunting strike.
hissatsu.name: Echo Ball

hissatsu.description: The ball flies high up into the air and plunges\ndown at high speed while spinning.
hissatsu.name: Steeple Shot

hissatsu.description: Take a deep breath and release it along with fiery\nflames to weaken and catch incoming shots.
hissatsu.name: Flame Breath

hissatsu.description: Three players line up and support the player in\nfront so that the first player can use their body\nto put up a strong guard.
hissatsu.name: Body Shield

hissatsu.description: Two players kick the ball to each other at full\nforce to amplify the power of the final shot.
hissatsu.name: Twin Boost

hissatsu.description: Strike with a serpentine drive that twists\nand coils, leaving the keeper bewildered.
hissatsu.name: Snake Shot

hissatsu.description: Unleash an electrifying double attack on the enemy\nfrom the top of a looming tower.
hissatsu.name: Perfect Tower

hissatsu.description: Command a dark, swirling hurricane to engulf\nthe incoming shot.
hissatsu.name: Psychlone

hissatsu.description: Create a large net that restricts\nthe opposition's movements.\nOnce caught, they are at the mercy of the hunter.
hissatsu.name: Hunter's Net

hissatsu.description: Unleash a water cannon from your mouth,\nsending the ball flying sky-high.
hissatsu.name: Hydro Breath

hissatsu.description: Rise high up like a bright blue tornado and aim for\nthe goal using a spinning back heel kick.
hissatsu.name: Back Tornado

hissatsu.description: Build a bridge using dark shockwaves to cancel out\nthe power of incoming shots and catch the ball.
hissatsu.name: Bridge to Nowhere

hissatsu.description: Make the ball vanish and reappear,\nconfounding the keeper at the last second.
hissatsu.name: Teleport Shot

hissatsu.description: Stop the momentum of incoming shots with sheer will,\nwithout even touching the ball.
hissatsu.name: Stomper Stopper

hissatsu.description: Focus all your strength into a shoulder tackle\nand snatch the ball.
hissatsu.name: Power Charge

hissatsu.description: Every beautiful rose hides its thorns.\nGraceful moves unleash this bewitching shot.
hissatsu.name: Bed of Roses

hissatsu.description: Jump high up using another player as a stepping stone\nand dive down swiftly like a shooting star for a\nsliding tackle.
hissatsu.name: Shooting Star

hissatsu.description: Steal the ball and swap it for a fake, tricking\nopponents with an upgraded version of Fake Ball.
hissatsu.name: Fake Bomber

hissatsu.description: Seize the ball with a jaw of sculpted might in an\neye-catching, maw-tastic bite.
hissatsu.name: Maw-Ment of Truth

hissatsu.description: Two players soar up like eagles to deliver a\npowerful twin shot from mid-air.
hissatsu.name: Eagle Buster

hissatsu.description: A strange teleportation device appears above,\nswapping you and your foe's positions.
hissatsu.name: Transporter Device

hissatsu.description: One player makes an acrobatic flip with the help of\nanother and uses the momentum to strike the ball\nwith the hip.
hissatsu.name: Acrobat Bomber

hissatsu.description: A sharp roundhouse creates a crescent of blue energy\nthat blasts opponents aside with great force!
hissatsu.name: Spinning Cut

hissatsu.description: Shatter the pitch with a brilliant flash,\nblinding all in your path and charging ahead.
hissatsu.name: Grand Glow

hissatsu.description: Send forth a giant tangle of fisty fur to entangle\nthe ball and weaken its force.
hissatsu.name: Fur Trapper

hissatsu.description: Hammer a swirling corona of solar fire down onto\nthe ball with dynamic force.
hissatsu.name: Sun Block

hissatsu.description: Coil around the opponent quickly to create a wind\nspiral that blasts the opponent away.
hissatsu.name: Coil Turn

hissatsu.description: Conjure illusions of yourself to baffle defenders\nand dance past them with uncanny flair.
hissatsu.name: Phantasm Dribble

hissatsu.description: He might be cute, but this baby\ndragon has a shot like lightning!
hissatsu.name: Baby Corodragon

hissatsu.description: Three powerful kicks push the shot to evolve\nthe triple shot closer to its ultimate form.
hissatsu.name: Triple Threat

hissatsu.description: Spin the ball into a spiraling tempest that\ntwists and turns to catch the keeper\ncompletely off guard.
hissatsu.name: Swirly Shot

hissatsu.description: Outmaneuver with swift, sharp steps before\ncharging past opponents in a burst of speed.
hissatsu.name: Acrobatic Keep

hissatsu.description: Rush at the goal like a destructive tornado.\nThe move is difficult to control, but will never miss.
hissatsu.name: Spinning Shot

hissatsu.description: Obstruct the opposition's advance by freezing the pitch.\nShut them out completely at absolute zero.
hissatsu.name: Frozen Steal

hissatsu.description: Release stored power from a fist to fire a strong\nbeam that hits the ball back.
hissatsu.name: Fist Beam

hissatsu.description: Call upon a meteor shower from outer space\nto repel the incoming opposition.
hissatsu.name: Asteroid Belt

hissatsu.description: Unleash a fiery shot from midair.\nThe deadly ball enveloped in flames pierces\nstraight to the goal.
hissatsu.name: Fire Tornado

hissatsu.description: Lift and control the ball midair with psychokinetic\npower, then slam it into the goal.
hissatsu.name: Psycho Shot

hissatsu.description: This looming wall is an ironclad defence\nthat strikes fear into the heart of opponents.
hissatsu.name: Iron Wall

hissatsu.description: Conjure up a concealing mist which\nprevents the opposition from knowing\nthat the ball has been stolen from them.
hissatsu.name: Mystifying Mist

hissatsu.description: Slam a headbutt that shakes the ground\nand blasts the ball skyward.
hissatsu.name: Volcano Head

hissatsu.description: Swing from vine to vine like Tarzan and use the\nmomentum to unleash a forceful shot.
hissatsu.name: Tarzan Kick

hissatsu.description: Channel dark, ethereal hands from your arms,\nsmashing the ball head-on to block any shot.
hissatsu.name: Capable Hands

hissatsu.description: Spin like a top to whip up a tornado and blast\nany approaching foes aside.
hissatsu.name: Supreme Spin

hissatsu.description: Gather solar energy to forge a guillotine and cut\nthe ball with a scorching blade.
hissatsu.name: Raiser Blade

hissatsu.description: Launch a shot of unfathomable power that transforms\ninto a dragon, thrashing toward the goal.
hissatsu.name: Last Resort

hissatsu.description: Like a butterfly's flapping wings,\ntwo perfectly in sync players combine their powers\nand put the opposition in a trance.
hissatsu.name: Butterfly Trance

hissatsu.description: Swing your teammates like a club for a\ngame-changing, hole-in-one strike.
hissatsu.name: Utter Gutsiness Club

hissatsu.description: Combine the strength of three into one colossal\nGod Hand for massive power.
hissatsu.name: Triple God Hand

hissatsu.description: Strike from behind with a sneaky knee, then\nsnatch the ball while they stagger.
hissatsu.name: About Face

hissatsu.description: Dive at the shot with your diamond-hard right hand\nand swing a full-power punch!
hissatsu.name: Diamond Knuckle

hissatsu.description: Wrest for possession of the ball with an aggressive,\nhigh-speed slide tackle\nthat conjures countless afterimages.
hissatsu.name: Killer Slide

hissatsu.description: Spin the ball with precise, hoop-like mastery\nto lock down opponents and clear a way to goal.
hissatsu.name: Hoopsie-Loop

hissatsu.description: A dark tornado of forbidden power engulfs\nthe goal with its cursed flames.
hissatsu.name: Dark Tornado

hissatsu.description: Transform the ball into a massive sigil\nand crush defenders from above.
hissatsu.name: Seal Matrix

hissatsu.description: Harness repulsion and suction to hover\nand drive forward like a motor vehicle.
hissatsu.name: Guided Collide

hissatsu.description: Each move is charged with power, then unleashed.\nA master's skill learned only by kung fu experts.
hissatsu.name: Kung Fu Fighting

hissatsu.description: Rush at a cyclone-caught opponent like a piercing\narrow while the referee is looking away.
hissatsu.name: Hurricane Arrows

hissatsu.description: Race at breakneck pace, clawing past opponents\nwith sheer grit and determination.
hissatsu.name: Endeavor Rush

hissatsu.description: Smash the ground with all your might, sinking\nthe goalposts and deflecting the shot.
hissatsu.name: Desecrater

hissatsu.description: Stir up a violent sandstorm to lower visibility and\nattack the opponent to steal the ball away.
hissatsu.name: Slice and Dice

hissatsu.description: Infuse the ball with lunar power and whip it\ninto a curving arc toward the goal.
hissatsu.name: Crescent Kick

hissatsu.description: Launch a rapid flurry of punches, then finish with\na knockout strike that blasts the target away.
hissatsu.name: Whip Crack

hissatsu.description: Unleash explosive momentum and crash through\nthe opposition in a thundering, unstoppable rush.
hissatsu.name: Runaway Bull

hissatsu.description: Two players form a whirling wheel and slam\ninto opponents, sending them flying.
hissatsu.name: Rolling Hell

hissatsu.description: Move so fast the eye can't keep up.\nDodge rivals with this ninja technique.
hissatsu.name: Afterimage

hissatsu.description: This shot is many times more fang-tastically\npowerful than Jurassic Jaws.
hissatsu.name: Fangtasmagoria

hissatsu.description: Teammates on each hand of the goalkeeper generate\na high-voltage barrier to protect the goal.
hissatsu.name: High Voltage

hissatsu.description: Unleash a hundred empowered shadows that\ncrush everything in their path with devastating force.
hissatsu.name: Shadow Swarm

hissatsu.description: Gather swirling winds into the ball and launch it\nfrom the heavens toward the goal.
hissatsu.name: Triple G Strike

hissatsu.description: Bolt forward with two allies as an unstoppable\ntrio that barrels through defenders.
hissatsu.name: Triple Dash

hissatsu.description: Face off against any shot with a gigantic right hand\nmanifested from motivation, effort, and determination.
hissatsu.name: God Hand

hissatsu.description: Unleash a ferocious streak of fiery sumo slaps on\nthe ball to cause a large explosion that blows it\nbackwards.
hissatsu.name: Nitro Slap

hissatsu.description: Bend the foe's vision and vanish like a ghost\nto then slip past like an invisible gust.
hissatsu.name: Invisible Fake

hissatsu.description: Strike the ball with trifecta force to send it\nsurging forward like a razor-sharp blade.
hissatsu.name: One for All

hissatsu.description: A combo move that works together with Fire Tornado\nby boosting its power.
hissatsu.name: Twin Boost F

hissatsu.description: Harry the opposition with\na merciless roar borne from a dragon's might.
hissatsu.name: Dreamscape: Dragon Crash

hissatsu.description: Imbue the ball with explosive solar\nenergy and fire off a shot engulfed in crimson flames.
hissatsu.name: Atomic Flare

hissatsu.description: Summon a swirling leaf tornado to guard the goal\nand knock away the ball.
hissatsu.name: Mistral

hissatsu.description: Transform the ball into a boomerang so that it\nreturns after being kicked.
hissatsu.name: Boomerang Bluff

hissatsu.description: Two players support their goalkeeper from behind to\nstop incoming shots with the power of friendship.
hissatsu.name: Triple Defence

hissatsu.description: The ball sticks to your feet like magic,\ndribbling in midair without ever falling.
hissatsu.name: Super Elastico

hissatsu.description: Rise through multiple death zones and\nunleash a dark, searing blast toward Earth.
hissatsu.name: Final Death Zone

hissatsu.description: An ultimate attack that imprisons the keeper in permafrost.\nThe power dormant in the aurora\nbreaks the opposing ranks.
hissatsu.name: Northern Impact

hissatsu.description: Grab a round table-shaped earth fragment and flip it\nup in a display of sheer anger.
hissatsu.name: Table-Turner

hissatsu.description: Unleash a double strike, spinning the ball\nskyward and turning kicked-up dust into a\nraging surge of purple lightning.
hissatsu.name: Spring Thunderclap

hissatsu.description: Call down the ultimate Fire Tornado,\na blazing meteor strike that descends\nfrom the heavens to crush the keeper.
hissatsu.name: Meteoric Fire Tornado

hissatsu.description: An improved version of Dragon Crash that combines\nthe Wyvern's speed and power.
hissatsu.name: Wyvern Crash

hissatsu.description: Combine the strength of three into one colossal\nGod Hand for massive power.
hissatsu.name: Triple God Hand

hissatsu.description: Keep opponents away by creating a barrier using\nfire that gushes forth from the ground.
hissatsu.name: Flame Veil

hissatsu.description: A drive shot carried along by a cross-shaped aura\nformed through powerful kicks in two intersecting\ndirections.
hissatsu.name: Cross Drive

hissatsu.description: Bathed in the goddess's blessing, cradle the ball\nwith a power strong enough to shift continents.
hissatsu.name: Sacred Embrace

hissatsu.description: Hit the ground with full strength to make stone\npillars jut out and send the opponent flying.
hissatsu.name: Gravestone

hissatsu.description: Call forth a divine pillar of light\nusing a rising kick to send opponents flying.
hissatsu.name: Dawnrise

hissatsu.description: Catch any shot in a springy circular barrier\nand fling it back.
hissatsu.name: Bounce Handler

hissatsu.description: Infused with the wrath of God, the ball\npierces through all things like a divine arrow.
hissatsu.name: Divine Arrows

hissatsu.description: Slam the ball to send it crashing like\na meteor straight toward the goal!
hissatsu.name: Meteor Attack

hissatsu.description: Rotate at high frequencies like a prankster's toy top,\ncreating whirlwinds that are difficult to contend with.
hissatsu.name: Whirlwind Force

hissatsu.description: Run at full speed from a corner of the pitch and use\nthe immense momentum to punch the ball away.
hissatsu.name: Jumping Whack

hissatsu.description: Raise up stone barriers from the earth, forming a\nnarrow path of no escape before stealing the\nopponent's ball.
hissatsu.name: No Escape

hissatsu.description: Use a large player's body as a springboard to shoot\na high ball down like lightning from the sky.
hissatsu.name: Inazuma Drop

hissatsu.description: Concentrate your power to grow a massive\nleft hand and pluck the ball from the air.
hissatsu.name: Pinch and Save

hissatsu.description: Shape the ball with psychic force and fire it\nlike an arrow through the defence.
hissatsu.name: Psi Arrow

hissatsu.description: Alert the pitch to a mysterious flying rice ball\nand use the chaos to snatch the ball\nand break through.
hissatsu.name: Look! A Rice Ball

hissatsu.description: A flame-clad ball transforms into a phoenix\nthat dives directly for the goal!
hissatsu.name: The Phoenix

hissatsu.description: Summon a red dragon from the ground to break through\nthe opponent's defences.
hissatsu.name: Rising Dragon

hissatsu.description: Add an incredible backspin to the ball before\nlaunching it at the opponent, causing them to\nbe blown away.
hissatsu.name: Spin Out

hissatsu.description: Dominate the pitch with a foreboding\nthreat reminiscent of the galaxy and\nshoot with a comet-like high kick.
hissatsu.name: Meteor Blade

hissatsu.description: Unleash a towering waterfall of energy that\nsweeps across the pitch and keeps opponents at bay.
hissatsu.name: Niagara Falls

hissatsu.description: Raise your foot in a mighty sumo stomp\nto make the ground shake.
hissatsu.name: Sumo Stomp

hissatsu.description: Unleash an arm-like aura to snatch any shot from\nthe air—no matter the angle.
hissatsu.name: Grabber Arm

hissatsu.description: Unleash a low, sweeping strike that skims along\nthe ground and cuts the defender off their footing.
hissatsu.name: Low Scythe Slice

hissatsu.description: An invincible supergravity field emerges,\nmanipulating gravity to render enemies immobile.
hissatsu.name: Gravitation

hissatsu.description: Ensnare the ball in a flawless, mesmerizing melody,\ncontrolling it and stopping it cold.
hissatsu.name: Behind Bars

hissatsu.description: Power up a mighty header and strike the ball\nwith a lightning-fast downward volley.
hissatsu.name: Leaping Thunder

hissatsu.description: A forbidden ultimate technique that unleashes\npenguins who peck at feet with savage force.
hissatsu.name: Emperor Penguin No. 1

hissatsu.description: Break the ground apart with a devastating quake that\nblows everything away.
hissatsu.name: Mega Quake

hissatsu.description: Strike the ball with a flurry of kicks to sharpen\nthe ball into a diamond-bright shot.
hissatsu.name: Diamond Ray

hissatsu.description: A barely legal move that makes use of a teammate's\nIllusory Ball to hit and blast opponents away.
hissatsu.name: Foul Offence 3

hissatsu.description: Ride a giant ball with the Super Armadillo\nRodeo Clown and smash through enemies.
hissatsu.name: Armadillo Circus

hissatsu.description: Slip past in an instant with a vanishing act\nthat defies explanation.
hissatsu.name: Magic

hissatsu.description: Cloak the ball in a dark aura and launch a sharp\nstrike that attacks the keeper like a feral shark.
hissatsu.name: Shark Shooter

hissatsu.description: Envelop the ball in a holy melody of light and sound,\nthen strike it to purify everything in its path.
hissatsu.name: Hollow Blare

hissatsu.description: Unleash a sleek aquatic assault, sliding with deadly\nprecision to knock opponents aside\nand snatch the ball.
hissatsu.name: Killer Whale

hissatsu.description: A clever dribble that produces afterimages of the ball\nand visually tricks the opponents.
hissatsu.name: Illusory Ball

hissatsu.description: Spread a veil of eerie fog that unnerves the enemy,\nthen slip through the shadows to claim the ball.
hissatsu.name: Dark Mist

hissatsu.description: Do a bizarre dance with pattering feet to stir up a\ncloud of dust that blocks visibility.
hissatsu.name: Bewildered

hissatsu.description: Charge with unstoppable force to unleash\na wild, bison-like shot at the net.
hissatsu.name: Bull Rush

hissatsu.description: Release a mystical mist that lowers visibility and\nsteal the ball from a momentarily confused\nopponent.
hissatsu.name: Mystic Mist

hissatsu.description: Slam a colossal card down to knock opponents\nflying in a hyper-dimensional card strike.
hissatsu.name: Card Slap

hissatsu.description: Launch a header, hitting the ball with a giant hand\nraised above the head.
hissatsu.name: Megaton Head

hissatsu.description: Channel unstoppable force into a single strike\nto send the ball hurtling with devastating power.
hissatsu.name: Unify

hissatsu.description: Charge the ball with heavenly lightning and\ndrive it earthward in a blinding, electrifying strike.
hissatsu.name: Heavenly Thunder

hissatsu.description: The strongest of moves perfected by The Genesis.\nIts power far exceeds the boundaries of football\nknown to man.
hissatsu.name: Supernova

hissatsu.description: Spin your rhythmic ribbons to dazzle opponents\nand glide past the defence in a flourish.
hissatsu.name: Ribbon Shower

hissatsu.description: Smash a header with a colossal, gigaton-charged\naura driving the ball home.
hissatsu.name: Gigaton Head

hissatsu.description: The ball grows a pair of angelic white wings,\nmaking the opponent lose their will to fight.
hissatsu.name: Angel Ball

hissatsu.description: Two players' auras cross and swirl violently,\nunleashing a stunningly powerful combo shot.
hissatsu.name: Cross Fire

hissatsu.description: Evade the opponent with a light and breezy step,\nlike a gust of wind blowing through.
hissatsu.name: Easy Breezy

hissatsu.description: Merge three beings into one and behold the great Majin's\ndescent, six arms ready to stop any incoming shot.
hissatsu.name: Majin Merge

hissatsu.description: Use tricky movements to create an illusion of the\nplayer to deceive the opponent while dribbling.
hissatsu.name: Deceptor Dribble

hissatsu.description: Add a screw spin to a powerful header, blasting\nthe ball away with astonishing force.
hissatsu.name: Super Megaton Head

hissatsu.description: Trap the ball and unleash a flurry of brutal strikes\nfor utterly unrestrained foul offence.
hissatsu.name: Foul Offence 2

hissatsu.description: Combine The Wall with God Hand\nto block charging enemies like a dam.
hissatsu.name: Stone Wall

hissatsu.description: Team up for an explosive speed boost.\nA flying combination move powered by friendship.
hissatsu.name: Boost Glider

hissatsu.description: Outthink your opponents with supersonic strategy\nand take control of the ball.
hissatsu.name: Foil Formula

hissatsu.description: Strike with a blow carrying the hopes of your allies,\nsending the ball soaring onward with overwhelming power.
hissatsu.name: Fizzy Fire Lemonade

hissatsu.description: Awaken the legacy of Atlantis' ancient power\nand drive the ball back with its immense force.
hissatsu.name: Wall of Atlantis

hissatsu.description: Ignite your foot with flames and kick the ball with\nscorching force for a fierce, direct shot at the goal.
hissatsu.name: Bullseye Blaze

hissatsu.description: A high-speed, low-flying diving header\nwhich requires excellent synergy.
hissatsu.name: Pancake Defence

hissatsu.description: Accelerate to full speed to execute a super dribble\nmove that can't be stopped.
hissatsu.name: Dash Accelerator

hissatsu.description: Spin with theatrical grace and conjure an afterimage\nthat beguiles the opponent as you claim the ball.
hissatsu.name: Dramatic Swipe

hissatsu.description: Send the ball streaking like a meteor to produce\na supernova-level strike of unimaginable power.
hissatsu.name: Cosmic Blaster

hissatsu.description: Infuse the ball with Bahamut's force and speed,\nblasting it forward in a cataclysmic blow.
hissatsu.name: Bahamut Crash

hissatsu.description: Flick the ball up and lock it with four keys to\nsecure a straight path to the goal.
hissatsu.name: Security Shot

hissatsu.description: Whip up a sudden gust with a giant fan to blow\nopponents away in a move full of festive flair.
hissatsu.name: Big Fan

hissatsu.description: Whip a red cape to provoke the opponent and easily\nstep away when they charge madly.
hissatsu.name: Matador Feint

hissatsu.description: A divine ultimate technique that uses brilliantly\nbeautiful golden wings that captivate even the gods.
hissatsu.name: God Break

hissatsu.description: Strike from above with a thunderous kick\nto send the ball crashing like a solar blade\ntearing through storm clouds.
hissatsu.name: Sunshine Splitter

hissatsu.description: Launch the ball high and smash it with a mighty kick,\ntracing a sharp shot that gleams like a shooting star.
hissatsu.name: Meteor Blade A

hissatsu.description: Create a ring of ice that turns into icy attack\nblades with the snap of a finger.
hissatsu.name: Frosticle

hissatsu.description: The ball grows a pair of devilish black wings,\nmocking and confusing the opponent.
hissatsu.name: Devil Ball

hissatsu.description: Call forth a dark shockwave using a downward stomp\nto assault the opponent.
hissatsu.name: Duskfall

hissatsu.description: Summon a snapping carnivorous plant\nthat clamps down on the ball.
hissatsu.name: Venus Balltrap

hissatsu.description: Unleash an impossibly bright drive shot that blinds\nthe goalkeeper.
hissatsu.name: Shine Drive

hissatsu.description: Freeze your surroundings with a glacier stare, and\nunleash a fearsome ice-cold shot.
hissatsu.name: Freeze Shot

hissatsu.description: Tear open space itself and guide the ball along\na path carved by celestial hands.
hissatsu.name: Divine Deflectors

hissatsu.description: Steal the ball with a fiery roundhouse kick,\nTaekwondo-style.
hissatsu.name: Racing Flame

hissatsu.description: Use fiery breakdancing moves to steal the ball from\nthe opponent.
hissatsu.name: Flame Dance

hissatsu.description: Have your allies boost you skyward and\nfire a shot as you dive at blistering speed.
hissatsu.name: Hawk Shot

hissatsu.description: A triple-train-threat that seems silly, until it hits:\nblasting opponents away with awesome force.
hissatsu.name: Mad Express

hissatsu.description: Instill fear into the opposition with a wicked saw blade\nthat tears through ball and pitch alike.
hissatsu.name: Rotary Sander

hissatsu.description: Stir up a strong cyclone and dive in, using the air\ntunnel to go right past the opponent.
hissatsu.name: Tornado Tunnel

hissatsu.description: Infuse the ball with multidimensional\nenergies to travel at high speeds\nwith a destructive rotational force.
hissatsu.name: Astro Break

hissatsu.description: Unleash a spectral glare of burning purple energy\nthat causes enemies to tremble in sheer fear.
hissatsu.name: Ghoulish Glare

hissatsu.description: Charge like a raging bull and bulldoze\nall in your way.
hissatsu.name: Horn Train

hissatsu.description: Raise a shield forged from unwavering loyalty\nthat grows brighter and stronger with your heart.
hissatsu.name: Lunar Eclipse

hissatsu.description: Compress your aura and catch any fierce shot\nwith a diamondized hand.
hissatsu.name: Diamond Hand

hissatsu.description: Pound the pitch with a rock-fueled tempo\nas you weave through defenders with unbridled energy.
hissatsu.name: Amp Beat

hissatsu.description: Swing a towering greatsword to cleave the ground\nand crush everything beneath.
hissatsu.name: Atlas Sword

hissatsu.description: Harness the power of the earth to raise a wall,\nblocking the way and proving yourself a mighty defender.
hissatsu.name: The Wall

hissatsu.description: A move that lessens the burden of\nEmperor Penguin No. 1.\nSummon penguins that take to the skies for the empire.
hissatsu.name: Emperor Penguin No. 2

hissatsu.description: The player's prayer for victory results in a divine\nmiracle that intimidates the opponent.
hissatsu.name: Athena's Anthem

hissatsu.description: The howling of a wolf, illuminated by moonlight,\nmanifested as a pinpoint shot that roars across the pitch.
hissatsu.name: Legendary Wolf

hissatsu.description: Slam a foot down to generate a strong shockwave\nthat slices through the ground like a sharp blade.
hissatsu.name: Blade Attack

hissatsu.description: Skim across the sand in a wild drift, slipping\npast the defender through a veil of swirling dust.
hissatsu.name: Desert Drift

hissatsu.description: Harness the fiery power of two, whipping up\na scorching wind to snatch the ball.
hissatsu.name: Dual Storm

hissatsu.description: Call forth a trio of Majin, combining wind,\nthunder, and fire to defend against every shot
hissatsu.name: Mega Majin Trio

hissatsu.description: This isn't a handball, it's a kick!\nAfter gathering an enormous amount of\nenergy, take aim, and shoot!
hissatsu.name: Ganymede Ray
